details.en:
both `run_acl(x)` and `run_alscl(x)` accept a complete named input list. For `YTF_example`, they read the three tables and `x$fit_args`, then the matching `x$fit_config$acl` or `x$fit_config$alscl`. Explicit call arguments have highest priority, for example `run_acl(x, M = 0.25, nstarts = 4, ncores = 2)`. List-valued overrides (`parameters`, `map`, `control`) replace the whole stored list, and explicit `NULL` is retained. The simulation settings in `x$parameters` and the generating `x$truth` are not fitting arguments.

For your own data, `x` can instead be a flat named list containing `data.CatL`, `data.wgt`, `data.mat`, `rec.age`, `nage`, `M`, `sel_L50`, `sel_L95` and any optional fitting arguments. A structured bundle may omit `fit_config` to use the model defaults; if it includes `fit_config`, that list must contain the selected model. Duplicate, unnamed, unknown or missing required arguments produce an error before fitting. All calls use the existing fitting core and `alscl_speed()` settings; inspect `fit$sd_info` to see the actual standard-error method. `ncores` controls independent optimization starts, while `sd_cores` in `alscl_speed()` controls standard errors.

Natural and fishing mortality are instantaneous rates per model step; growth k is annual. Fixing survey catchability anchors the abundance scale. Zeros are excluded with `zero_action="missing"`; decide whether that is appropriate for your observations. `nstarts` controls the total starts and `ncores` limits simultaneous socket workers; by default nstarts = ncores for compatibility. `train_times` controls successive optimizer passes. Inspect `start_diagnostics` for worker PIDs, timing and convergence. A zero convergence code alone does not establish reliable inference. Keep the DLL loaded to evaluate `obj` in the same R session.

Starting values do not fix parameters. A whole `map = NULL` or `list()` applies model defaults: ACL fixes `log_std_log_F`, `logit_log_F_y`, `logit_log_F_a`, `t0`; ALSCL fixes `log_sigma_log_F`, `log_t0`. Pass named NULL entries directly to release default fixes; single-bracket assignment preserves them. See the own-data case study for the complete parameter checklist and working example.

## Optimization refinement and F shared across groups

`run_acl(x)` and `run_alscl(x)` now finish the selected fit with up to five safeguarded Newton steps (`polish = TRUE`). Each step requires a positive-definite numerical Hessian, parameters strictly inside their bounds, a smaller maximum absolute gradient, and an objective increase no greater than `1e-8` for floating-point roundoff. Refinement stops if a condition fails; it cannot repair insufficient information or an inappropriate model. Set `polish = FALSE` to skip it. This can change estimates at numerical precision, so complete fits are not guaranteed to be identical to those of older releases.

Repeated optimizer passes retain their raw parameters, objective, code and message in `fit$optimizer_history`. A failed restart does not replace an actual successful pass when the objective values differ by at most `1e-8` and every parameter differs by at most `1e-6 * max(1, abs(p1), abs(p2))`. These tolerances identify numerically equivalent repeated passes; meaningful objective improvements or separated parameter vectors still compete by the lower objective. All raw codes and messages remain in `optimizer_history`, and `raw_opt$selected_pass` identifies the retained pass. The final gradient, Hessian and boundary checks remain separate from the optimizer code. `fit$raw_opt` records the selected result before refinement; `fit$refinement` records accepted steps and before/after gradients. `convergence_code` remains the selected raw optimizer code, not an invented success code after refinement. Multistart selection still uses the lowest finite objective before refinement; `starts` and `start_diagnostics` describe those unrefined starts.

`fit$diagnostics` adds a separate numerical screen: maximum gradient below `1e-3`, positive-definite Hessian and covariance, no optimizer boundary and no natural-scale boundary. Free correlations within `1e-4` of 0 or 1 and free process/observation SDs at or below `1e-4` are flagged. These are screening thresholds, not statistical tests. `high_correlations` lists parameter pairs with absolute correlation at least 0.95; this warrants investigation but does not alone prove non-identifiability. The covariance condition number depends on parameter scaling. `diagnose_model()` prints the raw optimizer status and numerical screen separately; inspect residuals, alternative starts, profiles and sensitivity as well.

`F_structure="group_year"` estimates an age-by-time (ACL) or length-by-time (ALSCL) F process. `F_structure="year"` shares one F across all groups within each model time step, including one F per quarter for quarterly data. The unused group-correlation parameter is inactive in the shared structure.

Both fitting functions check the time grid directly: consecutive numeric column labels must differ by `growth_step`. For annual data, `2000, 2001, 2003` is rejected because 2002 is absent. Keep 2002 as an all-`NA` survey column, and provide complete weight and maturity columns for that period. Quarterly labels such as `2000, 2000.25, 2000.5` require `growth_step = 0.25`. The model does not interpolate missing periods or reinterpret irregular intervals.

提供初值不等于固定参数。整个 `map = NULL` 或 `list()` 使用模型默认规则：ACL 固定 `log_std_log_F`、`logit_log_F_y`、`logit_log_F_a`、`t0`；ALSCL 固定 `log_sigma_log_F`、`log_t0`。直接传入具名 NULL 项可解除默认固定，用单方括号赋值保留它。正式数据案例列有完整参数分类和可执行示例。

## 优化收尾与每时间步跨组共用 F

`run_acl(x)` 和 `run_alscl(x)` 默认对选中的拟合执行最多五步受保护的 Newton 收尾（`polish = TRUE`）。每步要求数值 Hessian 正定、参数严格位于上下界内、最大绝对梯度下降，且目标函数增加不超过 `1e-8` 的浮点舍入容差。不满足条件就停止；收尾不能补足资料信息，也不能修复不合适的模型。`polish = FALSE` 可跳过收尾。这可能改变数值精度层面的估计，因此 完整拟合不保证与旧版本逐位相同。

每轮优化的原始参数、目标函数、代码和信息保存在 `fit$optimizer_history`。如果目标函数值之差不超过 `1e-8`，且每个参数之差不超过 `1e-6 * max(1, abs(p1), abs(p2))`，失败重启不会覆盖实际返回成功的轮次。这些容差只用于识别数值上等价的重复轮次；目标函数有实质改善或参数向量相距较远时，仍选择较低的目标函数值。全部原始退出码和消息保留在 `optimizer_history`，`raw_opt$selected_pass` 指出所保留轮次。最终梯度、Hessian 和边界检查仍独立于优化器退出码。`fit$raw_opt` 保存收尾前选中的结果；`fit$refinement` 记录接受的步骤及前后梯度。`convergence_code` 始终表示所选优化轮次的原始代码，不会因收尾而强行改为成功。多起点仍按收尾前最低有限目标函数选取；`starts` 和 `start_diagnostics` 记录收尾前各起点的结果。

`fit$diagnostics` 增加独立的数值筛查：最大梯度小于 `1e-3`、Hessian 与协方差正定、不触及优化器边界或自然尺度边界。自由相关系数距离 0 或 1 不超过 `1e-4`，以及自由过程／观测标准差不超过 `1e-4`，都会标记。这些是筛查阈值，不是统计检验。`high_correlations` 列出绝对相关系数至少 0.95 的参数对，需进一步审查，但不能单凭高相关就断言不可识别。协方差条件数取决于参数尺度。`diagnose_model()` 分别显示原始优化代码和数值筛查结果；仍需检查残差、多起点、似然剖面和敏感性。

`F_structure="group_year"` 使用年龄×时间（ACL）或体长×时间（ALSCL）的 F 过程。`F_structure="year"` 在每个模型时间步内跨组共用一个 F，季度数据即每季度一个 F；共用结构中不使用的组别相关参数处于 inactive 状态。

两个核心拟合函数直接检查时间网格：相邻数值表头之差必须等于 `growth_step`。年度数据 `2000, 2001, 2003` 会因缺少 2002 而报错；应保留 2002 列，调查值填 `NA`，并提供该期完整的重量和成熟数据。季度表头如 `2000, 2000.25, 2000.5` 必须设置 `growth_step = 0.25`。模型不会自动插补缺失时间步，也不会把不规则间隔重新解释为等间隔。

`F_structure="group_year"` 使用年龄×时间（ACL）或体长×时间（ALSCL）的 F 过程。`F_structure="year"` 在每个模型时间步内跨组共用一个 F，季度数据即每季度一个 F；共用结构中不使用的组别相关参数处于 inactive 状态。

两个核心拟合函数直接检查时间网格：相邻数值表头之差必须等于 `growth_step`。年度数据 `2000, 2001, 2003` 会因缺少 2002 而报错；应保留 2002 列，调查值填 `NA`，并提供该期完整的重量和成熟数据。季度表头如 `2000, 2000.25, 2000.5` 必须设置 `growth_step = 0.25`。模型不会自动插补缺失时间步，也不会把不规则间隔重新解释为等间隔。

description.en: Set how fits compute standard errors and which automatic-differentiation library TMB uses. Parallel standard errors match sequential calculations at the same fitted parameters; the optimizer finishing step can change the optimum.
description.zh: 设置拟合时计算标准误的方式以及 TMB 使用的自动微分库。相同拟合参数处的并行标准误与顺序计算一致；优化收尾可能改变最优点。

value.en: The previous `ALSCL.sd_cores` and `ALSCL.framework` options, returned invisibly; `options(old)` restores them.
value.zh: 不可见地返回原 `ALSCL.sd_cores` 与 `ALSCL.framework` 选项，可用 `options(old)` 恢复。

details.en:
`sd_cores` computes standard errors on several cores; the results are identical to the sequential calculation. On macOS and Linux outside GUI front-ends, forked processes compute the fixed-effect Hessian and the delta method. On Windows, in GUI front-ends such as RStudio and with Apple's Accelerate BLAS, socket workers compute the delta method when it would take more than about 3 seconds, and the Hessian is computed in the main process. Fits that already run on parallel workers, as in `retro_model()` and `sim_acl()`, use one core each. `framework = "TMBad"` speeds up each evaluation of the Laplace approximation, but results differ slightly from CppAD. Use `alscl_speed_info()` to see what the settings mean on your computer; docs/SPEED_GUIDE.md explains every setting.

Installed socket workers load the same package installation as the parent. During `pkgload::load_all()` or `testthat::test_local()`, workers instead load the same source checkout with pkgload. Install the optional development dependency pkgload for this workflow. CI exercises both source-mode parallel tests and the complete installed-package checks.
details.zh:
`sd_cores` 用多个核计算标准误，结果与顺序计算逐位相同。在 macOS、Linux 且不在图形界面中运行时，用分叉进程计算固定效应 Hessian 与 delta 方法；在 Windows、RStudio 等图形界面以及 Apple Accelerate BLAS 下，当 delta 方法预计超过约 3 秒时由 socket 进程计算，Hessian 在主进程计算。已在并行进程中运行的拟合（如 `retro_model()`、`sim_acl()`）每个只用 1 核。`framework = "TMBad"` 可加快拉普拉斯近似的每次计算，但结果与 CppAD 略有差异。用 `alscl_speed_info()` 查看设置在本机上的实际效果；各项设置的详细说明见 docs/SPEED_GUIDE.md。

安装模式的 socket 工作进程继续加载与主进程相同的包安装。在 `pkgload::load_all()` 或 `testthat::test_local()` 下，工作进程改为用 pkgload 加载同一源码目录；该开发流程需要可选依赖 pkgload。CI 同时运行源码模式并行测试和完整安装包检查。

description.en: Show the current standard-error cores, execution method, reason and AD library. Cross-version numerical identity is not guaranteed because adds optimizer refinement.
description.zh: 显示标准误核数、执行方式、原因及 AD 库。新增优化收尾，不保证跨版本逐位一致。

value.en: A data frame with class alscl_speed_info and columns item (setting or information item) and value. It reports standard-error workers, computation method and reason, the automatic-differentiation framework, the TMB version and the cross-version numerical-identity notice.
value.zh: 带有 alscl_speed_info 类的两列数据框：item 是设置或说明项目，value 是其值。内容包括标准误核数、计算方式及原因、自动微分框架、TMB 版本及跨版本数值一致性提示。

details.en: Call it before fitting to check that a session gets the expected speed-up, and record its output with results. After a fit, `fit$sd_info` records what was actually done (method, cores, seconds).
details.zh: 拟合前调用以确认本会话能获得预期的加速，并可与结果一同记录。拟合后，`fit$sd_info` 记录实际的计算方式、核数和耗时。

description.en: Construct estimation starting values and lower/upper bounds, optionally using a species preset.
description.zh: 创建估计初值及上下界，可选择物种预设。

value.en: A list with parameters (starts), parameters.L (lower bounds) and parameters.U (upper bounds). Each is a named list on the optimizer scale, with names matching the selected TMB model.
value.zh: 包含 parameters（初值）、parameters.L（下界）和 parameters.U（上界）的列表；三个元素均为优化器尺度上的命名列表，名称对应所选 TMB 模型参数。

details.en:
Species presets are estimation starting points, not input data or automatically applied biological assumptions. `create_parameters_alscl()` selects the ALSCL parameterization. ACL uses `t0`; ALSCL uses `log_t0`. Use named arguments and pass the resulting lists to the fitting function.

`create_parameters(species = "krill", model_type = "acl")` supplies a Linf start of 90 and bounds, but does not fix Linf or change M, nage or the time step. To fix it, explicitly pass `map = list(log_Linf = factor(NA))` with the chosen starting value. Biological settings still belong in the fitting arguments.
details.zh:
物种预设提供估计起点，不会自动更改观测数据、自然死亡率、年龄网格或调查可捕性。`create_parameters_alscl()` 选择 ALSCL 参数化。ACL 使用 `t0`，ALSCL 使用 `log_t0`。建议使用命名参数，并将返回列表传给拟合函数。

`create_parameters(species = "krill", model_type = "acl")` 提供 Linf 初值 90 和边界，不会自动固定 Linf，也不更改 M、nage 或时间步长。需要固定时，显式传入 `map = list(log_Linf = factor(NA))` 和选定初值；生物设置仍需在拟合参数中提供。

description.zh: 创建估计初值及上下界，可选择物种预设。

description.en: Merge the default ACL parameter map with custom fixes and releases.
description.zh: 合并 ACL 默认参数映射与自定义的固定或释放设置。

value.en: A named TMB mapping list combining ACL defaults and supplied settings. factor(NA) fixes a parameter; a named NULL entry releases that default fix.
value.zh: 合并 ACL 默认规则与用户设置后的具名 TMB 映射列表。factor(NA) 固定参数；具名 NULL 项解除该项默认固定。

details.en: `factor(NA)` fixes a parameter at the supplied initial value. A named `NULL` releases a default fixed parameter; unspecified default mappings remain. This helper uses ACL defaults. Use model-specific names when specifying an ALSCL map. The returned list drops NULL entries. Do not feed it back into `run_acl()` to release a default fix, because the fitter will add the absent default again. Use `run_acl(x, map = list(t0 = NULL))` directly instead. A whole NULL/empty map retains model defaults.
details.zh: `factor(NA)` 将参数固定在所给初值。命名项 `NULL` 可释放默认固定的参数，未指定的默认映射仍保留。本辅助函数使用 ACL 默认值；ALSCL 映射必须使用该模型的参数名称。 返回列表会移除 NULL 项；不要用其返回值再次传给 `run_acl()` 来解除默认固定，因为拟合函数会重新补入缺失默认项。应直接用 `run_acl(x, map = list(t0 = NULL))`。整个 NULL 或空 map 仍使用模型默认规则。

description.en: Evaluate the von Bertalanffy mean length-at-age curve.
description.zh: 计算 von Bertalanffy 平均体长—年龄曲线。

value.en: A numeric vector of mean lengths, corresponding to `age`.
value.zh: 与 `age` 对应的平均体长数值向量。

details.en: Computes `Linf * (1 - exp(-k * (age - t0)))`. Use years for age and t0 and inverse years for k. The result describes mean growth, without individual variation or parameter uncertainty.
details.zh: 计算 `Linf * (1 - exp(-k * (age - t0)))`。age 与 t0 使用年，k 使用每年。结果表示平均生长，不含个体差异或参数估计不确定性。

description.en: Evaluate a logistic curve defined by lengths at 50% and 95%.
description.zh: 根据 50% 与 95% 对应体长计算 logistic 曲线。

value.en: A numeric vector of proportions at the supplied lengths.
value.zh: 所给体长对应的比例数值向量。

details.en: For increasing maturity curves use `L95 > L50`; descending selectivity permits `L95 < L50`. Equality is invalid. Used for maturity and, in the simulator, catchability/selectivity curves. The same equation does not make these biological concepts interchangeable.
details.zh: 上升成熟曲线使用 `L95 > L50`；下降选择性允许 `L95 < L50`，两者不能相等。函数可用于成熟比例，模拟器也用其构造可捕性或选择性曲线。数学表达式相同，不代表这些生物学概念相同。

description.en: Build biological and process settings for a simulation operating model.
description.zh: 创建模拟操作模型的生物参数和过程设置。

value.en: A named parameter list with species, age/time/length grids, growth, mortality, recruitment, observation and process settings.
value.zh: 包含物种、年龄/时间/体长网格、生长、死亡率、补充、观测和过程设置的命名参数列表。

details.en:
Species presets select the operating-model structure: flatfish and krill use age_based; tuna uses length_based. Inspect the returned model_type, then call sim_cal() and sim_data(). These simulation labels differ from the estimator choices acl and alscl. The simulator and estimator recruitment processes differ.

`mean_F` in the quick annual simulator is the arithmetic mean of the generated F trajectory; `mean_F = 0` generates zero F.

For the full simulator, `nyear` and `burn_in` are durations in years and must each contain a whole number of `growth_step` intervals. Thus a half-year burn-in is valid with quarterly steps, but not annual steps. Returned `sm$nyear` counts retained steps. `first.year` labels the first retained observation, and `sm$years` records the complete retained calendar. `simulation_to_tables()` and `sim_acl()` preserve this calendar; old files lacking year metadata still have a documented 2000-based fallback. A single retained period stays a matrix, although fitting requires at least two periods.

`sim_acl()` resolves path and parameter variables before sending tasks to socket workers, so ordinary console/script calls work with multiple cores. Retain failed replicates and inspect each fit's diagnostics; successful worker execution alone does not establish a usable assessment.
details.zh:
物种预设决定操作模型结构：flatfish 和 krill 使用 age_based，tuna 使用 length_based。检查返回的 model_type，再调用 sim_cal() 与 sim_data()。模拟结构标签与估计模型 acl、alscl 不同；模拟器与估计器的补充过程也不同。

快速年度模拟器的 `mean_F` 等于生成 F 序列的算术平均值；`mean_F = 0` 生成零捕捞死亡率。

完整模拟器的 `nyear`、`burn_in` 都以年为单位，且分别必须对应整数个 `growth_step`。因此季度模式允许半年预热，年度模式不允许。返回的 `sm$nyear` 是保留时间步数；`first.year` 是第一期保留观测的年份，`sm$years` 保存完整观测时间轴。`simulation_to_tables()` 和 `sim_acl()` 保留这条时间轴；完全没有年份元数据的旧文件仍可使用从 2000 开始的后备规则。只保留一期时仍返回矩阵，但拟合至少需要两期。

`sim_acl()` 在发送 socket 任务前求值路径与参数变量，因此一般控制台或脚本中的变量传参也支持多核。保留失败重复并检查逐次拟合诊断；工作进程运行成功并不单独证明评估结果可用。

description.en: Derive biological arrays and transition matrices from simulation parameters.
description.zh: 从模拟参数计算生物数组和转移矩阵。

value.en: A list of biological arrays: model_type identifies the operating-model structure; LatA is mean length at age; W_at_len is individual weight at length; mat is maturity; q_surv is survey catchability; sel is fishery selectivity; pla is the matrix of length probabilities conditional on age. Length coordinates and bounds are included. Gij is the one-step length-growth transition matrix for length_based models and NULL for age_based models. The list also retains biology_inputs, the canonical biological parameters used to derive the arrays.
value.zh: 生物数组列表：model_type 为生成模型结构；LatA 为平均年龄别体长；W_at_len 为体长别平均个体重量；mat 为成熟比例；q_surv 为调查可捕性；sel 为渔业选择性；pla 为给定年龄的体长概率矩阵。另含体长组坐标和边界；length_based 模型的 Gij 为体长组间一步生长转移矩阵，age_based 模型的 Gij 为 NULL。 另保留 biology_inputs，记录生成数组时采用的规范化生物学参数。

details.en:
`pla` gives length-bin probabilities conditional on age. In the age_based simulator its rows are ages and columns are length bins (each row sums to one); in the length_based simulator its rows are length bins and columns are ages (each column sums to one). `Gij[i, j]` instead gives the probability of moving from source length bin j to destination bin i over one model step; each column sums to one. Call sim_cal() again after modifying biological parameters.

`sim_data()` checks both these inputs and the actual arrays against `sim_cal(params)` before drawing random numbers or writing files. Recalculate biology after changing growth, ages, time step, bins, weight, maturity, catchability or fishery selectivity; editing arrays by hand is not supported. Changing only mortality, recruitment, error, simulation duration or calendar settings does not require recalculating biology. Legacy objects without biology_inputs remain valid when their arrays match.
details.zh:
`pla` 表示给定年龄的体长组概率。age_based 模拟器中行为年龄、列为体长组，每行和为 1；length_based 模拟器中行为体长组、列为年龄，每列和为 1。`Gij[i, j]` 则表示一个模型时间步内从源体长组 j 转入目标组 i 的概率，每列和为 1。修改生物参数后需重新调用 sim_cal()。

`sim_data()` 在抽取随机数或写文件前，同时核对来源参数和实际数组是否与 `sim_cal(params)` 一致。修改生长、年龄、时间步、体长组、重量、成熟、调查可捕性或渔业选择性后须重算生物学数组；不支持手动编辑数组。只修改死亡率、补充量、误差、模拟时长或日期，无须重算生物学数组。缺少 biology_inputs 的旧对象只要数组一致仍可使用。

description.en: Simulate population dynamics, survey observations and known truth after burn-in.
description.zh: 模拟预热后的种群动态、调查观测及已知真值。

value.en: The replicate selected by return_iter; NULL selects the largest ID in iter_range. The result includes survey numbers SN_at_len, population numbers at length N_at_len and at age N_at_age, SSB, Rec, fishery catch, and time, age and length metadata. All replicates are also written to output_dir as `sim_rep<id>` files containing sim.data.
value.zh: 返回 return_iter 指定的重复结果；NULL 默认选择 iter_range 中的最大编号。结果包含调查数量 SN_at_len、种群体长别数量 N_at_len、年龄别数量 N_at_age、SSB、Rec、捕捞量及时间、年龄、体长等元数据。所有重复另以包含 sim.data 的 `sim_rep<id>` 文件写入 output_dir。

details.en:
Pass consistent outputs from `initialize_params()` and `sim_cal()`. `iter_range` selects replicate seeds. The operating model uses a stock–recruitment process that should not be confused with the fitted log-recruitment model.

`mean_F` in the quick annual simulator is the arithmetic mean of the generated F trajectory; `mean_F = 0` generates zero F.

For the full simulator, `nyear` and `burn_in` are durations in years and must each contain a whole number of `growth_step` intervals. Thus a half-year burn-in is valid with quarterly steps, but not annual steps. Returned `sm$nyear` counts retained steps. `first.year` labels the first retained observation, and `sm$years` records the complete retained calendar. `simulation_to_tables()` and `sim_acl()` preserve this calendar; old files lacking year metadata still have a documented 2000-based fallback. A single retained period stays a matrix, although fitting requires at least two periods.

`sim_acl()` resolves path and parameter variables before sending tasks to socket workers, so ordinary console/script calls work with multiple cores. Retain failed replicates and inspect each fit's diagnostics; successful worker execution alone does not establish a usable assessment.

Replicate IDs must be distinct nonnegative integers, including 0, in `sim_data()`, `sim_model()`, `sim_acl()` and `sim_alscl()`. Simulation uses each ID as its seed and fitting reads the matching `sim_rep<id>` file.

`sim_data()` checks both these inputs and the actual arrays against `sim_cal(params)` before drawing random numbers or writing files. Recalculate biology after changing growth, ages, time step, bins, weight, maturity, catchability or fishery selectivity; editing arrays by hand is not supported. Changing only mortality, recruitment, error, simulation duration or calendar settings does not require recalculating biology. Legacy objects without biology_inputs remain valid when their arrays match.
details.zh:
传入一致的 `initialize_params()` 和 `sim_cal()` 结果。`iter_range` 指定模拟重复及其种子。操作模型的亲体—补充过程应与拟合器的对数补充过程区分。

快速年度模拟器的 `mean_F` 等于生成 F 序列的算术平均值；`mean_F = 0` 生成零捕捞死亡率。

完整模拟器的 `nyear`、`burn_in` 都以年为单位，且分别必须对应整数个 `growth_step`。因此季度模式允许半年预热，年度模式不允许。返回的 `sm$nyear` 是保留时间步数；`first.year` 是第一期保留观测的年份，`sm$years` 保存完整观测时间轴。`simulation_to_tables()` 和 `sim_acl()` 保留这条时间轴；完全没有年份元数据的旧文件仍可使用从 2000 开始的后备规则。只保留一期时仍返回矩阵，但拟合至少需要两期。

`sim_acl()` 在发送 socket 任务前求值路径与参数变量，因此一般控制台或脚本中的变量传参也支持多核。保留失败重复并检查逐次拟合诊断；工作进程运行成功并不单独证明评估结果可用。

`sim_data()`、`sim_model()`、`sim_acl()` 和 `sim_alscl()` 的重复编号须为互不重复的非负整数，可以包含 0。模拟以编号作为随机种子，拟合读取对应的 `sim_rep<id>` 文件。

`sim_data()` 在抽取随机数或写文件前，同时核对来源参数和实际数组是否与 `sim_cal(params)` 一致。修改生长、年龄、时间步、体长组、重量、成熟、调查可捕性或渔业选择性后须重算生物学数组；不支持手动编辑数组。只修改死亡率、补充量、误差、模拟时长或日期，无须重算生物学数组。缺少 biology_inputs 的旧对象只要数组一致仍可使用。

description.en: Generate small annual teaching datasets in the three-table input format.
description.zh: 快速生成三表格式的年度教学数据。

value.en: A list with three aligned tables: data.CatL (survey numbers or indices), data.wgt (mean individual weights) and data.mat (mature proportions), plus true_params (generating parameters and truth records).
value.zh: 列表包含 data.CatL（调查数量指数）、data.wgt（平均个体重量）、data.mat（成熟比例）三张对齐表，以及 true_params（生成时使用的参数及真值记录）。

details.en:
Set a seed for reproducible examples. `cv_catch` is an observation CV, not a log-scale SD. Use `initialize_params()` → `sim_cal()` → `sim_data()` for the full age- or length-based operating model and quarterly scenarios. `save_csv=TRUE` writes the three tables.

`mean_F` in the quick annual simulator is the arithmetic mean of the generated F trajectory; `mean_F = 0` generates zero F.

For the full simulator, `nyear` and `burn_in` are durations in years and must each contain a whole number of `growth_step` intervals. Thus a half-year burn-in is valid with quarterly steps, but not annual steps. Returned `sm$nyear` counts retained steps. `first.year` labels the first retained observation, and `sm$years` records the complete retained calendar. `simulation_to_tables()` and `sim_acl()` preserve this calendar; old files lacking year metadata still have a documented 2000-based fallback. A single retained period stays a matrix, although fitting requires at least two periods.

`sim_acl()` resolves path and parameter variables before sending tasks to socket workers, so ordinary console/script calls work with multiple cores. Retain failed replicates and inspect each fit's diagnostics; successful worker execution alone does not establish a usable assessment.

The quick simulator now integrates the first and last length bins to negative and positive infinity, matching the fitted models. Finite `bin_breaks` still determine labels and midpoints; they do not truncate probability. Corrected simulations can change even with the same seed, especially when the first boundary excludes small fish. Previously saved datasets retain their original generating truth. Use nonnegative M, F and noise scales, positive growth parameters and a nonnegative weight coefficient, and increasing selectivity/maturity endpoints. Invalid parameters or nonfinite generated values stop before CSV files are created. The full simulator also requires normalized age-length keys and growth transitions.

设置种子可复现结果。`cv_catch` 是观测 CV，并非对数尺度 SD。完整年龄或长度结构模拟及季度场景应使用 `initialize_params()` → `sim_cal()` → `sim_data()`。`save_csv=TRUE` 会写出三张表。

快速年度模拟器的 `mean_F` 等于生成 F 序列的算术平均值；`mean_F = 0` 生成零捕捞死亡率。

完整模拟器的 `nyear`、`burn_in` 都以年为单位，且分别必须对应整数个 `growth_step`。因此季度模式允许半年预热，年度模式不允许。返回的 `sm$nyear` 是保留时间步数；`first.year` 是第一期保留观测的年份，`sm$years` 保存完整观测时间轴。`simulation_to_tables()` 和 `sim_acl()` 保留这条时间轴；完全没有年份元数据的旧文件仍可使用从 2000 开始的后备规则。只保留一期时仍返回矩阵，但拟合至少需要两期。

`sim_acl()` 在发送 socket 任务前求值路径与参数变量，因此一般控制台或脚本中的变量传参也支持多核。保留失败重复并检查逐次拟合诊断；工作进程运行成功并不单独证明评估结果可用。

description.en: Summarize survey fit and numerical convergence.
description.zh: 汇总调查拟合与数值收敛诊断。

value.en: A data frame with Metric and Value, combining in-sample fit metrics with optimizer, gradient, Hessian and boundary diagnostics. When diagnostics are available, it also includes the numerical screen, covariance condition number and count of highly correlated parameter pairs. Undefined or unavailable metrics are NA; key diagnostics are also printed.
value.zh: 包含 Metric（指标名称）和 Value（数值）的数据框，合并样本内拟合误差与优化、梯度、Hessian 和边界诊断；已有 diagnostics 时还包括数值筛查、协方差条件数及高相关参数对数量。未定义或不可用的指标为 NA，同时在控制台打印主要诊断。

details.en: Only finite positive survey observations enter prediction metrics. Predictions are `exp(Elog_index)`, the median on the original scale, without lognormal mean correction. MASE uses within-length one-step differences. AIC/BIC count free outer parameters; compare only compatible fits to the same observations. Inspect gradient, Hessian and boundaries separately.
details.zh: 预测误差指标仅使用有限且大于零的调查观测。预测为 `exp(Elog_index)`，即原尺度中位数，未作对数正态均值校正。MASE 使用同一体长组相邻时间步差。AIC/BIC 计数外层自由参数，仅应比较相同观测下相容的拟合。梯度、Hessian 和边界需分别检查。

description.en: Summarize survey fit with prediction errors and information criteria.
description.zh: 汇总调查拟合的预测误差和信息准则。

value.en: A data frame of in-sample fit metrics with columns Metric and Value. Undefined metrics are NA.
value.zh: 包含 Metric（指标名称）和 Value（数值）的样本内拟合指标数据框；未定义的指标为 NA。

MASE uses within-length one-step differences. AIC/BIC count free outer parameters; compare only compatible fits to the same observations. Inspect gradient, Hessian and boundaries separately.

description.en: Compare two fitted ACL/ALSCL results numerically.
description.zh: 对两个 ACL/ALSCL 拟合结果进行数值比较。

value.en: Invisibly returns a list: summary compares optimizer status, objectives, information criteria and timing; growth contains growth parameters; fit_metrics contains in-sample survey-fit errors; correlation contains Pearson correlations and Ratio_Mean (model2/model1) for shared population series. fit_diagnostics records numerical diagnostics. comparison contains data_verified, eligible, preferred and issues; a preference is reported only when comparison conditions are met. model1_name and model2_name retain display labels.
value.zh: 不可见地返回列表：summary 为优化状态、目标函数、信息准则和耗时比较；growth 为生长参数；fit_metrics 为样本内调查拟合误差；correlation 为共同种群时间序列的 Pearson 相关系数及均值比 Ratio_Mean（model2/model1）。fit_diagnostics 保存数值诊断；comparison 包含数据是否核验（data_verified）、比较是否满足条件（eligible）、满足条件时的优选标签（preferred）及问题（issues）。model1_name 和 model2_name 保存显示标签。

details.en:
Model 1 is the reference. `Ratio_Mean` is mean(model2)/mean(model1), not the mean of pointwise ratios. Use identical data and compatible likelihoods for information-criterion comparisons, and assess each fit numerically before ranking models.

`compare_models()` checks both fits against the supplied survey table: time labels, length-bin labels and order, positive observed values and their observation mask must agree. A known mismatch is an error. Older saved results without enough metadata remain readable, but automatic preference is withheld. If either fit fails the numerical screen, the function warns and retains raw AIC/BIC and fit statistics for inspection without declaring a preferred model. Read `comparison$fit_diagnostics` and `comparison$comparison` (`data_verified`, `eligible`, `preferred`, `issues`). A passed screen permits a conditional comparison; you must still assess likelihood comparability and biological assumptions.
details.zh:
模型 1 是参照。`Ratio_Mean` 为模型 2 均值除以模型 1 均值，不是逐期比值的平均。信息准则比较应使用相同观测和相容似然，排序前应检查每个拟合的数值状态。

 `compare_models()` 会核对两个拟合与传入调查表的时间标签、体长标签及顺序、正观测值和观测掩码；确认不一致时直接报错。旧保存结果若缺少核对所需元数据，仍可读取原始统计量，但不自动给出模型偏好。任一拟合未通过数值筛查时，函数发出警告，保留原始 AIC/BIC 和拟合指标供检查，不宣布哪个模型更优。查看 `comparison$fit_diagnostics` 与 `comparison$comparison`（`data_verified`、`eligible`、`preferred`、`issues`）。通过筛查只表示可以开展条件比较，仍需审查似然可比性和生物假设。

description.en: Refit after progressively removing terminal observations and summarize retrospective patterns.
description.zh: 逐次删除末端观测并重新拟合，汇总回溯模式。

value.en: A list with results (peel trajectories), last_points (terminal estimates), rho_by_peel (relative differences by peel), rho_text (numerically screened Mohn's rho) and raw_rho_text (unscreened descriptive summaries). fit_diagnostics and errors retain fit status and errors. model_type, workers and nstarts record model and computation settings. With plot=TRUE, plot contains the plot object, or NULL when no finite estimates can be drawn.
value.zh: 列表包含 results（各次回溯轨迹）、last_points（各轨迹末点）、rho_by_peel（逐次回溯的相对差异）、rho_text（通过数值筛查后汇总的 Mohn's rho）和 raw_rho_text（未筛查的描述性汇总）。fit_diagnostics 与 errors 保留逐次拟合状态和错误；model_type、workers、nstarts 记录模型与计算设置。plot=TRUE 时另返回 plot 对象；无有效估计可绘制时 plot 为 NULL。

details.en:
`retro_acl()` and `retro_alscl()` choose the model for `retro_model()`. The function fits the full dataset and the peels internally. Supply matching data, fixed assumptions, maps and bounds. Each peel removes one model time step, not necessarily one calendar year. Positive and negative terminal differences can cancel in Mohn’s rho.

The retrospective functions accept the same input bundle as the fitting functions: `retro_acl(x, nyear = 3)` and `retro_alscl(x, nyear = 3)`. The general form is `retro_model(data.CatL = x, model_type = "alscl", nyear = 3)`. Shared settings, then model-specific settings, then explicit call arguments determine each fit; explicit `map`, `parameters` and `control` replace their complete stored lists. `zero_action`, `control`, `nstarts`, `F_structure` and `polish` reach every fit. A fitting `ncores` stored in `x` is ignored: set `ncores` on the retrospective call for parallel peels. Within each peel, optimization starts run sequentially, with their number controlled by `nstarts`.

`fit_diagnostics` includes the full fit (`Peel = 0`) and every requested peel, with elapsed time, raw optimizer status, gradient, Hessian, boundaries and errors. `rho_by_peel` contains screened `Rho`, diagnostic `RawRho` and `Valid`. A quantity receives a reported value in `rho_text$Rho` only if the full fit and all requested peels pass the numerical screen and all terminal comparisons are finite with a nonzero reference. Otherwise it is `NA`, with a warning; failed peels are never silently dropped. `raw_rho_text` is an unscreened diagnostic summary, not a replacement for the screened result. It remains `NA` when a terminal comparison is missing. Available trajectories remain in `results` for inspection.

When all retrospective fits fail or no finite trajectories remain, `plot = TRUE` now warns and returns `plot = NULL` while preserving `fit_diagnostics`, `errors` and the unavailable rho values. Inspect those fields to correct the input or fitting problem. Requesting a plot must not prevent access to the failure record.

`fit_diagnostics` also retains `optimizer_message`, `selected_pass`, `optimizer_codes` and `optimizer_messages` for the selected pass and complete pass history. `refinement_status`, `refinement_steps` and `pre_refinement_max_gradient` show how Newton refinement changed the fit; `max_abs_gradient` remains the final gradient. Missing records from old or failed fits remain `NA`. A failed restart in the history does not invalidate an earlier selected successful pass, and a selected nonzero code is never relabeled as zero.
details.zh:
`retro_acl()`、`retro_alscl()` 为 `retro_model()` 选择模型。函数在内部拟合完整数据及各次删减数据。应提供匹配的数据、固定假设、映射和边界。每次删除一个模型时间步，不一定是一整年。Mohn rho 中正负终点差可能抵消。

可直接使用与拟合函数相同的输入：`retro_acl(x, nyear = 3)` 和 `retro_alscl(x, nyear = 3)`。通用写法为 `retro_model(data.CatL = x, model_type = "alscl", nyear = 3)`。各次拟合依次使用共用设置、模型专用设置及调用时显式覆盖值；显式 `map`、`parameters` 和 `control` 会整体替换对应列表。`zero_action`、`control`、`nstarts`、`F_structure` 和 `polish` 都传给每次拟合。`x` 内用于拟合的 `ncores` 不用于回溯：请在回溯调用中显式设置 `ncores`，控制同时运行的截短拟合数。每个截短拟合内部依序运行 `nstarts` 个起点。

`fit_diagnostics` 保存完整拟合（`Peel = 0`）和每个请求的截短拟合，包含耗时、原始优化状态、梯度、Hessian、边界与错误。`rho_by_peel` 包含筛查后的 `Rho`、诊断用的 `RawRho` 及 `Valid`。只有完整拟合和所有请求的截短拟合都通过数值筛查，且所有末端比较有限、参考值非零时，才在 `rho_text$Rho` 中报告该指标的 rho；否则返回 `NA` 并警告，不会悄悄删除失败的截短结果。`raw_rho_text` 是未经筛查的诊断汇总，不能替代正式报告值；若任一末端比较缺失，它仍为 `NA`。可用轨迹保留在 `results` 中供检查。

当全部回溯拟合失败或没有有限轨迹时，`plot = TRUE` 会警告并返回 `plot = NULL`，同时保留 `fit_diagnostics`、`errors` 及不可用的 rho。应根据这些字段修正输入或拟合设置。请求绘图不再阻止读取失败记录。

`fit_diagnostics` 还保留所选轮次及完整历史的 `optimizer_message`、`selected_pass`、`optimizer_codes`、`optimizer_messages`。`refinement_status`、`refinement_steps`、`pre_refinement_max_gradient` 记录 Newton 收尾的状态、步数和收尾前梯度；`max_abs_gradient` 仍为最终梯度。旧结果或失败拟合缺少的记录保留为 `NA`。历史中的失败重启不会使较早选中的成功轮次失效，选中的非零退出码也不会被改写为零。

当全部回溯拟合失败或没有有限轨迹时，`plot = TRUE` 会警告并返回 `plot = NULL`，同时保留 `fit_diagnostics`、`errors` 及不可用的 rho。应根据这些字段修正输入或拟合设置。请求绘图不再阻止读取失败记录。

`fit_diagnostics` 还保留所选轮次及完整历史的 `optimizer_message`、`selected_pass`、`optimizer_codes`、`optimizer_messages`。`refinement_status`、`refinement_steps`、`pre_refinement_max_gradient` 记录 Newton 收尾的状态、步数和收尾前梯度；`max_abs_gradient` 仍为最终梯度。旧结果或失败拟合缺少的记录保留为 `NA`。历史中的失败重启不会使较早选中的成功轮次失效，选中的非零退出码也不会被改写为零。

description.en: Refit after progressively removing terminal observations and summarize retrospective patterns.
description.zh: 逐次删除末端观测并重新拟合，汇总回溯模式。

value.en: A list with results (peel trajectories), last_points (terminal estimates), rho_by_peel (relative differences by peel), rho_text (numerically screened Mohn's rho) and raw_rho_text (unscreened descriptive summaries). fit_diagnostics and errors retain fit status and errors. model_type, workers and nstarts record model and computation settings. With plot=TRUE, plot contains the plot object, or NULL when no finite estimates can be drawn.
value.zh: 列表包含 results（各次回溯轨迹）、last_points（各轨迹末点）、rho_by_peel（逐次回溯的相对差异）、rho_text（通过数值筛查后汇总的 Mohn's rho）和 raw_rho_text（未筛查的描述性汇总）。fit_diagnostics 与 errors 保留逐次拟合状态和错误；model_type、workers、nstarts 记录模型与计算设置。plot=TRUE 时另返回 plot 对象；无有效估计可绘制时 plot 为 NULL。

details.en:
`retro_acl()` and `retro_alscl()` choose the model for `retro_model()`. The function fits the full dataset and the peels internally. Supply matching data, fixed assumptions, maps and bounds. Each peel removes one model time step, not necessarily one calendar year. Positive and negative terminal differences can cancel in Mohn’s rho.

The retrospective functions accept the same input bundle as the fitting functions: `retro_acl(x, nyear = 3)` and `retro_alscl(x, nyear = 3)`. The general form is `retro_model(data.CatL = x, model_type = "alscl", nyear = 3)`. Shared settings, then model-specific settings, then explicit call arguments determine each fit; explicit `map`, `parameters` and `control` replace their complete stored lists. `zero_action`, `control`, `nstarts`, `F_structure` and `polish` reach every fit. A fitting `ncores` stored in `x` is ignored: set `ncores` on the retrospective call for parallel peels. Within each peel, optimization starts run sequentially, with their number controlled by `nstarts`.

`fit_diagnostics` includes the full fit (`Peel = 0`) and every requested peel, with elapsed time, raw optimizer status, gradient, Hessian, boundaries and errors. `rho_by_peel` contains screened `Rho`, diagnostic `RawRho` and `Valid`. A quantity receives a reported value in `rho_text$Rho` only if the full fit and all requested peels pass the numerical screen and all terminal comparisons are finite with a nonzero reference. Otherwise it is `NA`, with a warning; failed peels are never silently dropped. `raw_rho_text` is an unscreened diagnostic summary, not a replacement for the screened result. It remains `NA` when a terminal comparison is missing. Available trajectories remain in `results` for inspection.

When all retrospective fits fail or no finite trajectories remain, `plot = TRUE` now warns and returns `plot = NULL` while preserving `fit_diagnostics`, `errors` and the unavailable rho values. Inspect those fields to correct the input or fitting problem. Requesting a plot must not prevent access to the failure record.

`fit_diagnostics` also retains `optimizer_message`, `selected_pass`, `optimizer_codes` and `optimizer_messages` for the selected pass and complete pass history. `refinement_status`, `refinement_steps` and `pre_refinement_max_gradient` show how Newton refinement changed the fit; `max_abs_gradient` remains the final gradient. Missing records from old or failed fits remain `NA`. A failed restart in the history does not invalidate an earlier selected successful pass, and a selected nonzero code is never relabeled as zero.

description.en: Compare observed and fitted survey indices across years or length bins.
description.zh: 按年份或体长组比较观测与拟合调查指数。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot`, `data1` (fitted) and `data2` (observed).
value.zh: ggplot 对象；`return_data=TRUE` 时返回含 `plot`、`data1`（拟合）、`data2`（观测）的列表。

details.en:
`facet_by = "length"` facets by length and shows time series; `facet_by = "year"` facets by time and shows length profiles. The default is log scale. With `exp_transform=TRUE`, fitted lines show original-scale medians, not a bias-corrected arithmetic mean.

Survey fit plots align both observed and predicted matrices by their positions and fitted calendar/length metadata, even if dimnames are added or removed. Missing and zero observations stay excluded. Use `exp_transform = FALSE` if exponentiating predictions would overflow. In residual plots, `resid_cap` must be a finite positive scalar or `NULL` to disable capping; negative or zero caps cannot erase the diagnostic pattern.

The default `plot_CatL(exp_transform = FALSE)` displays natural-log survey indices and labels that scale explicitly. `exp_transform = TRUE` displays original-scale survey indices; curves are fitted medians. An explicit `ylab` overrides the automatic label. Ridge compositions are normalized stably on the log scale, including very large or small finite log predictions; nonfinite predictions are rejected.

Titles identify survey indices. In `facet_by = "year"`, use `line_size1` for fitted lines and `line_size2` for observed lines; `line_size` and `point_size` control only `facet_by = "length"`. The global `CatL_by_year` title now applies to year facets.

The y-axis describes survey indices, not fishery catch. Set `acl_theme_set(ylab = list(survey = "Survey index (per tow)"))` to label single-model and comparison survey plots together. When `survey` is unset, a legacy customized `abundance` label is retained; otherwise the default is Survey index. The `catch` label continues to control actual catch plots only.
details.zh:
`facet_by = "length"` 按体长分面展示时间序列；`facet_by = "year"` 按时间分面展示体长剖面。默认是对数尺度；`exp_transform=TRUE` 显示原尺度中位数，不是偏差校正后的算术均值。

调查拟合图按矩阵位置及拟合年份、体长元数据对齐观测与预测，增删行列名不会改变坐标；缺失及零观测继续排除。若预测取指数会溢出，请使用 `exp_transform = FALSE`。残差图的 `resid_cap` 必须为有限正标量，或以 `NULL` 关闭截断；不再允许负值或零值抹去诊断特征。

默认 `plot_CatL(exp_transform = FALSE)` 绘制自然对数调查指数，并在纵轴标明尺度；`exp_transform = TRUE` 绘制原尺度调查指数，预测曲线为中位数。显式 `ylab` 覆盖自动标签。山脊图在对数尺度稳定归一化，极大或极小的有限对数预测仍可绘制；非有限预测会报错。

标题明确标为调查指数。`facet_by = "year"` 使用 `line_size1` 设置拟合线、`line_size2` 设置观测线；`line_size` 与 `point_size` 仅用于 `facet_by = "length"`。按年份分面时也遵守全局 `CatL_by_year` 标题。

纵轴表示调查指数，不是渔业捕获量。使用 `acl_theme_set(ylab = list(survey = "Survey index (per tow)"))` 可统一单模型和比较调查图的标签。未设置 `survey` 时保留旧的自定义 `abundance` 标签，否则默认 Survey index。`catch` 标签仅控制实际捕获量图。

description.en: Plot total or age-/length-specific abundance.
description.zh: 绘制总丰度、年龄别或体长别丰度。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot` and the processed `data`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象；`return_data=TRUE` 时返回含 `plot` 和整理后的 `data` 的列表。

details.en:
Choose `N`, `NA` or `NL`. Abundance is conditional on fixed survey catchability and other model assumptions.

Matrix dimnames are not indices; time and length labels come from fitted metadata. Standard errors must be complete, finite and nonnegative.

All modes inherit global titles (N, NA_, NL; interval variants use the corresponding `_se` keys, with `NA_se` for abundance at age), `xlab$year`, `ylab$abundance`, `x_breaks` and `x_expand`. A `title`, `xlab`, `ylab`, typography or line argument given in the call takes priority. Default panels have no gridlines.
details.zh:
选择 `N`、`NA` 或 `NL`。丰度以固定调查可捕性及其他模型假设为条件。

矩阵行列名称不作为下标；年份及体长标签来自拟合元数据。标准误必须完整、有限且非负。

所有模式继承全局标题（N, NA_, NL；区间使用对应的 `_se` 键，年龄丰度为 `NA_se`）、`xlab$year`、`ylab$abundance`、`x_breaks` 与 `x_expand`。调用中给出的 `title`、`xlab`、`ylab`、字体和线条参数优先，默认无网格。

details.en:
Recruitment enters the youngest modeled age group. Its scale is conditional on catchability assumptions.

Standard errors must be complete, finite and nonnegative; use `se = FALSE` for estimates only.

补充量进入模型的最小年龄组，尺度以可捕性等假设为条件。

标准误必须完整、有限且非负；仅绘制估计值时使用 `se = FALSE`。

description.zh: 展示拟合结果中的产卵生物量与补充量关系。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot` and the processed `data`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象；`return_data=TRUE` 时返回含 `plot` 和整理后的 `data` 的列表。

details.en:
This is a descriptive plot of fitted quantities; a smooth curve is not a fitted mechanistic stock–recruitment model or evidence of causation.

`age_at_recruitment` is in years. `plot_SSB_Rec()` divides it by the fit's `growth_step` and requires an integer lag on a regular time grid. With quarterly data, 0.25 means one step and 1 means four steps. Zero lag is allowed; negative, nonfinite and fractional-step lags are rejected. Legacy results without `growth_step` use their regular time spacing, or an annual step when neither metadata field is available.
details.zh:
这是拟合量之间的描述性图。平滑曲线不等于拟合了机制性的亲体—补充模型，也不构成因果证据。

`age_at_recruitment` 的单位是年。`plot_SSB_Rec()` 除以拟合的 `growth_step`，要求在规则时间网格上对应整数个时间步。季度数据中，0.25 表示滞后一季度，1 表示四季度。允许零滞后；拒绝负值、非有限值及非整数步滞后。旧结果没有 `growth_step` 时使用规则年份间隔；两类时间元数据都没有时沿用年度步长。

description.en: Plot estimated von Bertalanffy growth with optional uncertainty.
description.zh: 绘制估计的 von Bertalanffy 生长曲线及可选不确定性区间。

value.en: A ggplot object, suitable for further styling or `ggplot2::ggsave()`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象，可继续调整样式或用 `ggplot2::ggsave()` 保存。

details.en:
Intervals propagate available growth-parameter covariance. Fixed growth parameters can produce a zero-width interval. If usable covariance is unavailable, the function warns and plots the curve without an interval.

`ylab` is honored in every mode; unavailable covariance triggers a warning and an estimate-only curve that retains all custom styling.

`age_range = NULL` uses the fitted age range; older results without age metadata fall back to 1–25 years. The automatic lower endpoint is at least `t0`. An explicit range must be a finite increasing pair starting at or after `t0`; an automatic range with no positive span is rejected. Valid explicit ranges remain supported. Both confidence-interval styles retain the parameter annotation and honor `text_size`, `text_color`, `font_family`, and `ylab$growth`; explicit labels override global labels.
details.zh:
区间传播可用的生长参数协方差。生长参数固定时区间可退化为线；没有可用协方差时，函数提示并仅绘制曲线。

`ylab` 在所有模式生效；协方差不可用时提示并仅绘制曲线，保留全部自定义样式。

`age_range = NULL` 使用拟合年龄范围；旧结果没有年龄信息时回退到 1–25 岁，自动起点不早于 `t0`。显式范围必须是有限、递增且起点不早于 `t0` 的二元向量；自动范围没有正跨度时会报错。有效的显式范围仍可使用。两种区间样式均保留参数标注，并遵守 `text_size`、`text_color`、`font_family` 和 `ylab$growth`；单次调用的标签优先。

description.zh: 展示给定年龄的体长概率。

value.zh: ggplot 对象，可继续调整样式或用 `ggplot2::ggsave()` 保存。

details.en:
The heatmap shows the age–length key `pla`. It is not the one-step growth transition matrix G.

`plot_pla(x_breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15))` selects age-bin ticks without removing heatmap cells.
details.zh:
热图展示年龄—体长概率矩阵 `pla`，不是一步生长转移矩阵 G。

`plot_pla(x_breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15))` 选择年龄组刻度，不删除热图单元。

description.en: Plot fishing mortality by time and age or length.
description.zh: 按时间、年龄或体长绘制捕捞死亡率。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot` and the processed `data`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象；`return_data=TRUE` 时返回含 `plot` 和整理后的 `data` 的列表。

details.en:
ALSCL type="length" plots F against numeric `len_mid`, faceted by period; intervals use the same length-by-time cell order. type="year" plots time series by length group. ACL estimates F by age and has no length-specific F; its legacy type="length" alias still returns age curves but warns. Prefer type="age" for ACL. ALSCL age-specific F is derived from cohort survival. F remains per model time step.

Fishing-mortality plots use matrix positions and fitted time/group metadata, so matrix dimnames cannot alter the coordinates. Age panels in biomass, SSB, catch and F plots retain numeric group order with or without intervals. F plots and time-series comparisons require complete finite estimates and nonnegative finite standard errors when `se = TRUE`; missing summaries are errors rather than recycled values or silently removed intervals. Use `se = FALSE` explicitly for estimates only.

All modes inherit global titles `F_year`, `F_age`, or `F_length` (append `_se` for intervals), matching x-axis labels, `ylab$F`, `x_breaks`, and `x_expand`. Explicit plot arguments take priority. Default age coordinates are group indices and are labeled Age group. `base_theme` accepts a theme name such as `"theme_bw"` or a ggplot2 theme object such as `ggplot2::theme_bw()`; both preserve grid-free panels.
details.zh:
ALSCL 的 type="length" 以数值 `len_mid` 为横轴、按时期分面，区间按同一体长—时间单元顺序对应；type="year" 按体长组绘制时间序列。ACL 按年龄估计 F，没有体长别 F；旧 type="length" 别名仍返回年龄曲线并警告，ACL 请优先用 type="age"。ALSCL 的年龄别 F 从队列存活推导。F 始终按每个模型时间步计。

捕捞死亡率图按矩阵位置和拟合年份、组别元数据构造坐标，矩阵行列名不会改变坐标。生物量、SSB、捕获量和 F 的年龄分面在有无区间时都按数值组序排列。F 图和时间序列比较在 `se = TRUE` 时要求完整、有限的估计与有限非负标准误；缺失摘要会报错，不再重复填充或静默取消区间。只画估计时请明确使用 `se = FALSE`。

description.en: Plot log-scale survey residuals.
description.zh: 绘制调查指数的对数尺度残差。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot` and the processed `data`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象；`return_data=TRUE` 时返回含 `plot` 和整理后的 `data` 的列表。

details.en:
Both ACL and ALSCL fits are supported. `facet_by = "length"` uses time on the x-axis and one facet per length bin; `facet_by = "year"` uses length on the x-axis and one facet per model period, including quarterly periods. Residuals are observed log index minus fitted `Elog_index`. Missing and excluded observations are not evidence of a perfect fit. Inspect time and length structure as well as overall error size.

`plot_ridges()` and `plot_residuals()` use saved `observations` to preserve the same positive-observation mask as fitting; legacy fits can use their TMB data. NA and excluded zero cells are never converted to artificial observations or zero residuals. A wholly unobserved period has no observed ridge. With partial coverage, the observed ridge is normalized over observed positive cells, whereas predictions cover all bins: do not interpret this as agreement over unobserved bins. These plots work after removing `obj` from a fit that retains `observations`.

Both residual layouts honor per-call `title`, `xlab`, `ylab` and `title_hjust`. For example, `plot_residuals(b, facet_by = "year", title = "Survey residuals", xlab = "Length (cm)", ylab = "Log residual", title_hjust = 0)` uses the supplied labels and a left-aligned title. Default plots remain free of major and minor gridlines.

Survey fit plots align both observed and predicted matrices by their positions and fitted calendar/length metadata, even if dimnames are added or removed. Missing and zero observations stay excluded. Use `exp_transform = FALSE` if exponentiating predictions would overflow. In residual plots, `resid_cap` must be a finite positive scalar or `NULL` to disable capping; negative or zero caps cannot erase the diagnostic pattern.

Each facet selects its smoother independently using the number of distinct valid x values: fewer than 2 omits the trend, 2–5 uses a linear fit, and 6 or more uses loess with its own span. A sparse group never changes another group's trend.
details.zh:
支持 ACL 和 ALSCL 拟合。`facet_by = "length"` 横轴为时间、按体长组分面；`facet_by = "year"` 横轴为体长、按模型时期分面，也适用于季度时期。残差为观测对数指数减去拟合 `Elog_index`。缺失或排除的观测不意味着完美拟合；除误差大小外还应检查时间与体长结构。

`plot_ridges()` 和 `plot_residuals()` 使用保存的 `observations`，保留与拟合一致的正观测掩码；旧结果可读取 TMB 数据。NA 和拟合时排除的零值不会变成人造观测或零残差。整期缺测不绘制观测山脊；部分缺测时，观测比例只在有效正观测中归一化，预测比例则覆盖全部体长组，不能把它解释为未观测组也拟合良好。保留 `observations` 的拟合结果移除 `obj` 后仍可使用这两个绘图函数。

残差图的两种布局均遵守单次调用的 `title`、`xlab`、`ylab` 和 `title_hjust`。例如 `plot_residuals(b, facet_by = "year", title = "Survey residuals", xlab = "Length (cm)", ylab = "Log residual", title_hjust = 0)` 使用指定标签并左对齐标题。所有默认图继续不显示主、次网格线。

调查拟合图按矩阵位置及拟合年份、体长元数据对齐观测与预测，增删行列名不会改变坐标；缺失及零观测继续排除。若预测取指数会溢出，请使用 `exp_transform = FALSE`。残差图的 `resid_cap` 必须为有限正标量，或以 `NULL` 关闭截断；不再允许负值或零值抹去诊断特征。

每个分面按有效且不同的横坐标数量独立选择平滑方法：不足 2 个不画趋势，2–5 个使用线性拟合，6 个以上使用独立 span 的 loess。一个稀疏组不会改变其他组的趋势。

description.en: Plot recruitment or fishing-mortality process deviations.

details.en:
Select recruitment (`R`) or fishing mortality (`F`) and inspect whether the chosen display exponentiates log deviations. This function plots process deviations, not an overall likelihood-deviance statistic.

`se = FALSE` uses reported deviations without a standard-error table; intervals require complete, finite, nonnegative standard errors.

A `title`, `xlab`, `ylab` or typography argument given in the call replaces the corresponding theme setting. ACL F-deviation age panels keep numeric order.

`log = TRUE` labels log process deviations; `log = FALSE` labels multiplicative factors. Titles and y-axis labels use `dev_R`/`dev_F`, or `dev_R_multiplier`/`dev_F_multiplier` after exponentiation. These quantities are not likelihood deviances.
details.zh:
选择补充（`R`）或捕捞死亡率（`F`），并确认显示是否将对数偏差指数化。本函数绘制过程偏差，不是整体似然偏差统计量。

`log = TRUE` 标明对数过程偏差；`log = FALSE` 标明乘数。标题和纵轴标签分别使用 `dev_R`/`dev_F`，指数转换后使用 `dev_R_multiplier`/`dev_F_multiplier`。这些量不是似然偏差统计量。

details.en:
The default viridis progression encodes time.

`plot_ridges()` and `plot_residuals()` use saved `observations` to preserve the same positive-observation mask as fitting; legacy fits can use their TMB data. NA and excluded zero cells are never converted to artificial observations or zero residuals. A wholly unobserved period has no observed ridge. With partial coverage, the observed ridge is normalized over observed positive cells, whereas predictions cover all bins: do not interpret this as agreement over unobserved bins. These plots work after removing `obj` from a fit that retains `observations`.

Saved fits containing observations and fitted reports support `plot_ridges()` without a live TMB object. Older fits without saved observations still require their original live object or refitting. Record version, commit, seed, provenance, units, maps, bounds, time step and diagnostics. An RDS file does not preserve a portable compiled model. The default `plot_CatL(exp_transform = FALSE)` displays natural-log survey indices and labels that scale explicitly. `exp_transform = TRUE` displays original-scale survey indices; curves are fitted medians. Panel titles identify observed and fitted survey length compositions, normalized separately within each period; they do not describe total catch.
details.zh:
默认 viridis 渐变表示时间顺序。

`plot_ridges()` 和 `plot_residuals()` 使用保存的 `observations`，保留与拟合一致的正观测掩码；旧结果可读取 TMB 数据。NA 和拟合时排除的零值不会变成人造观测或零残差。整期缺测不绘制观测山脊；部分缺测时，观测比例只在有效正观测中归一化，预测比例则覆盖全部体长组，不能把它解释为未观测组也拟合良好。保留 `observations` 的拟合结果移除 `obj` 后仍可使用这两个绘图函数。

保存了观测与拟合报告的结果可直接使用 `plot_ridges()`，不需要活跃 TMB 对象。未保存观测的旧结果仍需原会话对象或重新拟合。记录包版本、提交号、随机种子、数据来源、三表单位、固定参数、边界、时间步和诊断；RDS 不保存可跨会话执行的编译模型。 默认 `plot_CatL(exp_transform = FALSE)` 绘制自然对数调查指数，并在纵轴标明尺度；`exp_transform = TRUE` 绘制原尺度调查指数，预测曲线为中位数。显式 `ylab` 覆盖自动标签。山脊图在对数尺度稳定归一化，极大或极小的有限对数预测仍可绘制；非有限预测会报错。

分面标题明确标为观测与拟合的调查体长组成，每个时段分别归一化；不表示总捕获量。

description.en: Compare population time series from two fitted models.
description.zh: 比较两个拟合模型的种群时间序列。

value.en: A ggplot object; with `return_data=TRUE`, a list with `plot` and the processed `data`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象；`return_data=TRUE` 时返回含 `plot` 和整理后的 `data` 的列表。

details.en:
Use compatible observations, units and time steps. Optional intervals are conditional on each model’s fixed assumptions.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. Time-series and F plots retain each fit's own calendar, including different time spans. Plots paired with `data.CatL` check known time and length metadata before matching observations to predictions; inconsistent grids are errors. A visual comparison does not establish that likelihoods or biological assumptions are comparable.

Fishing-mortality plots use matrix positions and fitted time/group metadata, so matrix dimnames cannot alter the coordinates. Age panels in biomass, SSB, catch and F plots retain numeric group order with or without intervals. F plots and time-series comparisons require complete finite estimates and nonnegative finite standard errors when `se = TRUE`; missing summaries are errors rather than recycled values or silently removed intervals. Use `se = FALSE` explicitly for estimates only.

`plot_compare_ts()` defaults to the common SSB, recruitment, B, N and CN series. Explicit CB comparisons require CB in both models (ACL does not report it); CB uncertainty is not reported by either current model. Every requested quantity must be available; unknown or unavailable quantities produce an error. For fishing mortality use `plot_compare_F_ts(a, b, method = "apical")` or `method = "mean"`. These summarize F across groups per model period, not across periods; the mean is unweighted. This helper does not provide an uncertainty interval for the aggregate.
details.zh:
应使用相容的观测、单位和时间步长。可选区间以各模型的固定假设为条件。

同一模型的两份结果会自动使用不同图例，例如 `ACL (group_year)` 和 `ACL (year)`，仍支持显式指定不同的 `model1_name`、`model2_name`。时间序列与 F 图保留每份结果自己的真实年份，可以显示不同时间范围。与 `data.CatL` 配对的图会核对已知时间和体长元数据，再匹配观测与预测；网格不一致时明确报错。图形比较不代表似然或生物假设具有可比性。

捕捞死亡率图按矩阵位置和拟合年份、组别元数据构造坐标，矩阵行列名不会改变坐标。生物量、SSB、捕获量和 F 的年龄分面在有无区间时都按数值组序排列。F 图和时间序列比较在 `se = TRUE` 时要求完整、有限的估计与有限非负标准误；缺失摘要会报错，不再重复填充或静默取消区间。只画估计时请明确使用 `se = FALSE`。

`plot_compare_ts()` 默认比较两模型共有的 SSB、补充量、B、N、CN。显式请求 CB 时，两模型都必须包含它（ACL 不报告 CB）；当前两模型均不报告 CB 标准误。请求的每种输出都必须存在；未知或不可用的输出会明确报错。捕捞死亡率请使用 `plot_compare_F_ts(a, b, method = "apical")` 或 `method = "mean"`。这两个选项分别取每个模型时期的组间最大值或非加权均值，不合并多个时期；该函数不提供汇总 F 的不确定性区间。

details.en:
Compares the same survey observations with exp(Elog_index) from both models, on the original scale. These predictions are medians, without lognormal mean correction.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. Time-series and F plots retain each fit's own calendar, including different time spans. Plots paired with `data.CatL` check known time and length metadata before matching observations to predictions; inconsistent grids are errors. A visual comparison does not establish that likelihoods or biological assumptions are comparable.

Point sizes inherit global `point_size` (default 2.5) unless `compare_point_size` explicitly overrides comparison plots. A per-call `point_size` takes priority; in `plot_compare_CatL()`, a legacy `obs_size` takes priority over the theme. Use `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` to restore global inheritance.
details.zh:
在原始尺度比较同一调查观测与两个模型的 exp(Elog_index)。这些预测是中位数，没有作对数正态均值校正。

同一模型的两份结果会自动使用不同图例，例如 `ACL (group_year)` 和 `ACL (year)`，仍支持显式指定不同的 `model1_name`、`model2_name`。时间序列与 F 图保留每份结果自己的真实年份，可以显示不同时间范围。与 `data.CatL` 配对的图会核对已知时间和体长元数据，再匹配观测与预测；网格不一致时明确报错。图形比较不代表似然或生物假设具有可比性。

点大小继承全局 `point_size`（默认 2.5），除非显式设置 `compare_point_size` 覆盖比较图。调用中的 `point_size` 优先；`plot_compare_CatL()` 的旧参数 `obs_size` 优先于主题。用 `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` 恢复全局继承。

description.zh: 比较汇总捕捞死亡率时间序列。

details.en:
`apical` and `mean` summarize the groups of each model time step differently; quarterly fits stay per quarter and are not annualized.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. details.zh:
`apical` 与 `mean` 对每个模型时间步的各组汇总方式不同；季度拟合按季度计，不做年化。

同一模型的两份结果会自动使用不同图例，例如 `ACL (group_year)` 和 `ACL (year)`，仍支持显式指定不同的 `model1_name`、`model2_name`。时间序列与 F 图保留每份结果自己的真实年份，可以显示不同时间范围。图形比较不代表似然或生物假设具有可比性。

description.en: Compare growth curves and optional external age–length references.
description.zh: 比较生长曲线及可选的外部年龄—体长参照。

value.en: A plot composition that can be displayed or saved with `ggplot2::ggsave()`.
value.zh: 可直接显示或用 `ggplot2::ggsave()` 保存的组合图对象。

details.en:
External data or supplied reference parameters must have matching age and length units. Simulated truth is an illustration, not independent validation.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. Time-series and F plots retain each fit's own calendar, including different time spans. Plots paired with `data.CatL` check known time and length metadata before matching observations to predictions; inconsistent grids are errors. A visual comparison does not establish that likelihoods or biological assumptions are comparable.

When supplying `ref_data`, use a nonempty `ref_name` distinct from both model labels; duplicate names are rejected before fitting the reference curve.

Point sizes inherit global `point_size` (default 2.5) unless `compare_point_size` explicitly overrides comparison plots. A per-call `point_size` takes priority; in `plot_compare_CatL()`, a legacy `obs_size` takes priority over the theme. Use `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` to restore global inheritance.

Omit `age_range` to use the combined fitted age range, starting at or after both models' `t0`. A model without saved age metadata contributes the legacy range 1-20 years. An explicit range must contain two finite increasing ages and start at or after both `t0` values. A range with no positive span is rejected.

The optional reference curve is drawn only at ages at or above its own fitted `t0`. If its fitted growth parameters are invalid or no positive age span remains, a warning explains why the reference curve is omitted; the assessment curves and observed points remain.
details.zh:
外部数据或所给参照参数必须使用匹配的年龄和体长单位。模拟真值用于说明，不是独立验证。

同一模型的两份结果会自动使用不同图例，例如 `ACL (group_year)` 和 `ACL (year)`，仍支持显式指定不同的 `model1_name`、`model2_name`。时间序列与 F 图保留每份结果自己的真实年份，可以显示不同时间范围。与 `data.CatL` 配对的图会核对已知时间和体长元数据，再匹配观测与预测；网格不一致时明确报错。图形比较不代表似然或生物假设具有可比性。

提供 `ref_data` 时，`ref_name` 必须为非空字符串，且与两个模型标签均不同；重复名称会在拟合参考曲线前报错。

点大小继承全局 `point_size`（默认 2.5），除非显式设置 `compare_point_size` 覆盖比较图。调用中的 `point_size` 优先；`plot_compare_CatL()` 的旧参数 `obs_size` 优先于主题。用 `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` 恢复全局继承。

省略 `age_range` 时，采用两份拟合年龄的合并范围，起点不早于两个模型的 `t0`。缺少年龄信息的旧结果使用 1-20 岁范围。显式范围须为两个有限且递增的年龄，起点不早于两个 `t0`；没有正跨度的范围会报错。

可选参考曲线仅在不早于其自身拟合 `t0` 的年龄绘制。若其生长参数无效，或没有剩余的正年龄跨度，会警告说明省略参考曲线的原因；评估模型曲线和观测点仍保留。

description.en: Compare fixed survey catchability curves.
description.zh: 比较固定的调查可捕性曲线。

value.en: A ggplot object, suitable for further styling or `ggplot2::ggsave()`.
value.zh: ggplot 对象，可继续调整样式或用 `ggplot2::ggsave()` 保存。

details.en:
The historical function name says selectivity, but the plotted q curves come from supplied survey catchability settings. They are not estimated fishery selectivity.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. Time-series and F plots retain each fit's own calendar, including different time spans. Plots paired with `data.CatL` check known time and length metadata before matching observations to predictions; inconsistent grids are errors. A visual comparison does not establish that likelihoods or biological assumptions are comparable.

Point sizes inherit global `point_size` (default 2.5) unless `compare_point_size` explicitly overrides comparison plots. A per-call `point_size` takes priority; in `plot_compare_CatL()`, a legacy `obs_size` takes priority over the theme. Use `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` to restore global inheritance.

Saved assessments from `read_assessment()` can be plotted directly: fixed survey catchability is recovered from the retained input recipe. A legacy live fit can use its TMB data; an older saved fit without the required inputs must first be saved again with its original input bundle `x`.
details.zh:
函数历史名称含 selectivity，但 q 曲线来自所给的固定调查可捕性设置，并非估计得到的渔业选择性。

同一模型的两份结果会自动使用不同图例，例如 `ACL (group_year)` 和 `ACL (year)`，仍支持显式指定不同的 `model1_name`、`model2_name`。时间序列与 F 图保留每份结果自己的真实年份，可以显示不同时间范围。与 `data.CatL` 配对的图会核对已知时间和体长元数据，再匹配观测与预测；网格不一致时明确报错。图形比较不代表似然或生物假设具有可比性。

点大小继承全局 `point_size`（默认 2.5），除非显式设置 `compare_point_size` 覆盖比较图。调用中的 `point_size` 优先；`plot_compare_CatL()` 的旧参数 `obs_size` 优先于主题。用 `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` 恢复全局继承。

`read_assessment()` 读取的评估结果可直接绘图，固定调查可捕性从保留的输入配方恢复。旧会话中的拟合可使用其 TMB 数据；若旧保存结果缺少所需输入，须先用原始输入列表 `x` 重新保存。

description.en: Compare residual distributions and structure between models.
description.zh: 比较模型间的残差分布与结构。

value.en: A plot composition that can be displayed or saved with `ggplot2::ggsave()`.
value.zh: 可直接显示或用 `ggplot2::ggsave()` 保存的组合图对象。

details.en:
Use the same observation cells and inspect both distributions and systematic patterns. Residual similarity does not establish identical population estimates.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. Time-series and F plots retain each fit's own calendar, including different time spans. A visual comparison does not establish that likelihoods or biological assumptions are comparable.

A per-call `point_size` takes priority; in `plot_compare_CatL()`, a legacy `obs_size` takes priority over the theme. Use `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` to restore global inheritance.
details.zh:
应使用相同观测单元，并同时检查分布和系统性模式。残差相近不代表种群估计相同。

同一模型的两份结果会自动使用不同图例，例如 `ACL (group_year)` 和 `ACL (year)`，仍支持显式指定不同的 `model1_name`、`model2_name`。时间序列与 F 图保留每份结果自己的真实年份，可以显示不同时间范围。与 `data.CatL` 配对的图会核对已知时间和体长元数据，再匹配观测与预测；网格不一致时明确报错。图形比较不代表似然或生物假设具有可比性。
