description.en: Display selected fit and information-criterion comparisons.
description.zh: 展示所选拟合指标与信息准则的比较。

value.en: A plot composition that can be displayed or saved with `ggplot2::ggsave()`.
value.zh: 可直接显示或用 `ggplot2::ggsave()` 保存的组合图对象。

details.en:
Different panels use different units and optimization directions. Numerical convergence and likelihood comparability must be checked before interpreting ranks.

The metric bars now use the same calculation as `diagnostic_metrics()`: only finite positive observations contribute, so missing and zero observations do not turn every error metric into `NA`. Nonfinite predictions at observed cells and mismatched dimensions are errors. Undefined measures, such as R-squared for constant observations, remain `NA`. The figure is descriptive; use `compare_models()` to check comparability and numerical eligibility before interpreting differences.

Comparison plots give distinct default labels to two fits of the same model: for example, `ACL (group_year)` and `ACL (year)`. Explicit distinct `model1_name` and `model2_name` remain supported. Time-series and F plots retain each fit's own calendar, including different time spans. Plots paired with `data.CatL` check known time and length metadata before matching observations to predictions; inconsistent grids are errors. A visual comparison does not establish that likelihoods or biological assumptions are comparable.

Retrospective rho labels and comparison metric labels inherit `font_family`, including explicit per-call fonts where supported.
details.zh:
不同面板的单位及优劣方向不同。解读排名前须检查数值收敛和似然可比性。

指标柱图现在与 `diagnostic_metrics()` 共用计算方法，只纳入有限正观测；缺失值和零值不会再令全部误差指标变成 `NA`。观测单元中的非有限预测及维度不一致会报错；常数观测的 R² 等无定义指标仍保留为 `NA`。图形用于描述比较，解读差异前应使用 `compare_models()` 核对数据可比性和数值状态。

同一模型的两份结果会自动使用不同图例，例如 `ACL (group_year)` 和 `ACL (year)`，仍支持显式指定不同的 `model1_name`、`model2_name`。时间序列与 F 图保留每份结果自己的真实年份，可以显示不同时间范围。与 `data.CatL` 配对的图会核对已知时间和体长元数据，再匹配观测与预测；网格不一致时明确报错。图形比较不代表似然或生物假设具有可比性。

回溯图 rho 和比较图数值标注继承 `font_family`；支持单次调用字体参数的函数也遵守该设置。

description.en: Read the active global ALSCL plotting settings.
description.zh: 读取当前全局 ALSCL 绘图设置。

value.en: The complete settings list when `what=NULL`, or the requested setting otherwise.
value.zh: `what=NULL` 时返回完整设置列表，否则返回指定设置项。

details.en: Function-level arguments override inherited settings where supported. Use `acl_theme_set()` to change defaults and `acl_theme_reset()` to restore package defaults.
details.zh: 支持的函数级参数可覆盖继承的全局设置。使用 `acl_theme_set()` 修改默认值，使用 `acl_theme_reset()` 恢复包默认值。

figure.code: plot_SSB(b, se = TRUE) under each palette of acl_theme_set()

description.en: Set global plot colors, typography, labels and layout defaults.
description.zh: 设置全局绘图颜色、字体、标签和布局默认值。

value.en: The previous `acl.theme` option, returned invisibly. The active global option is updated.
value.zh: 不可见地返回原 `acl.theme` 选项，并更新当前全局选项。

details.en:
Choose supported ggsci palettes or explicit role colors. Omitted arguments leave existing settings unchanged. Explicit `x_breaks = NULL` restores automatic breaks and `ylab = list(survey = NULL)` clears a survey-label override. Snapshots from `acl_theme()` preserve these nullable settings for `do.call(acl_theme_set, old)`. Changes apply to subsequently constructed plots, not already-created plot objects.

Point sizes inherit global `point_size` (default 2.5) unless `compare_point_size` explicitly overrides comparison plots. A per-call `point_size` takes priority; in `plot_compare_CatL()`, a legacy `obs_size` takes priority over the theme. Use `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` to restore global inheritance.
details.zh:
可选择支持的 ggsci 色板或直接指定各角色颜色。省略参数保留现有设置。显式 `x_breaks = NULL` 恢复自动刻度，`ylab = list(survey = NULL)` 清除调查标签覆盖值。`acl_theme()` 保存这些可为空的设置，供 `do.call(acl_theme_set, old)` 恢复。修改对之后构造的图生效，不会改动已经生成的图对象。

点大小继承全局 `point_size`（默认 2.5），除非显式设置 `compare_point_size` 覆盖比较图。调用中的 `point_size` 优先；`plot_compare_CatL()` 的旧参数 `obs_size` 优先于主题。用 `acl_theme_set(compare_point_size = NULL)` 恢复全局继承。

description.en: Restore the package’s default global plotting settings.
description.zh: 恢复包的默认全局绘图设置。

value.en: Invisibly returns NULL after resetting the option and printing a confirmation.
value.zh: 重置选项并打印提示后，不可见地返回 NULL。

details.en: This changes global plot settings for future plots in the current R session. It does not refit models or alter their estimates.
details.zh: 重置当前 R 会话中后续绘图使用的全局设置，不会重新拟合模型或更改估计值。

description.en: Check complete data and model settings before compiling or fitting.
description.zh: 在编译或拟合之前检查完整数据和模型设置。

value.en: A list with valid, model, errors, warnings, summary, time and length_bins. Invalid inputs return valid = FALSE with an error message.
value.zh: 返回 valid、model、errors、warnings、summary、time 和 length_bins。输入不合法时 valid = FALSE，并给出错误原因。

details.en: Shares the actual fitting preparation for table alignment, time spacing, bins, biology, starts, bounds and maps. Does not compile TMB or optimize. Summary includes positive/zero/missing observations, entirely unobserved periods/bins and independent free fixed/random parameter counts. Warnings identify excluded zeros, unobserved blocks and positive observations no more numerous than free fixed parameters. These are input screens, not evidence of identifiability, convergence or biological adequacy.
details.zh: 与核心拟合共用三表、时间间隔、体长边界、生物学输入、初值、上下界和 map 的准备逻辑，不编译 TMB、不优化。摘要列出正值、零值、缺失值、完全无观测的时段／体长组，以及独立自由固定效应／随机效应数量。警告指出排除的零值、无观测区块，以及正观测数不超过自由固定效应数的情况。这些只是输入检查，不证明可辨识性、收敛或生物学适用性。

description.en: Inspect conditional observation residuals with a time–length heatmap, actual-time lag correlations and a normal QQ plot.
description.zh: 用时间–体长热图、按实际时间间隔计算的滞后相关及正态 QQ 图检查条件观测残差。

value.en: A list with residuals, lag_correlations (length, lag, elapsed_time, n_pairs, correlation, status), pooled qq_data, plots$heatmap, plots$lag, plots$qq, time_step and interpretation notes. Unavailable correlations are NA with an explicit status.
value.zh: 列表包含残差表 residuals、滞后相关表 lag_correlations（体长、滞后、实际时间差、有效配对数、相关系数与状态）、汇总 QQ 数据、三张图 plots$heatmap/lag/qq、time_step 和解释说明。无法计算的相关系数保留为 NA，并给出原因。

details.en: residuals(fit, type = "log") returns a long table of observed minus fitted log index; type = "standardized" divides by the fitted observation SD. It retains original observations, model times and length coordinates, marks excluded cells, and assigns NA residuals to zero/missing observations. check_fit() uses standardized residuals. Gaps are never compressed; correlations require at least three finite paired values at the requested actual lag and nonconstant values on both sides. These residuals condition on fitted latent effects: standardization is not a guarantee of independence, calibrated tests or model adequacy. Plots follow the package's grid-free theme.
details.zh: residuals(fit, type = "log") 返回观测对数值减去拟合对数值的长表；type = "standardized" 再除以拟合的观测标准差。表中保留原始观测、模型时间与体长坐标，标记被排除的单元，零值或缺失观测的残差为 NA。check_fit() 使用标准化残差。缺失时段不会压缩；相关系数要求在指定实际时间间隔上至少有三对有限观测，且两侧均非常数。这些残差以拟合的潜在效应为条件：标准化不代表残差独立、检验已校准或模型适合度已得到证明。绘图遵循包的无网格主题。

description.zh: 统一提取带坐标的种群估计
description.en: Extract population estimates with coordinates

value.zh: 含量名、实际报告名、年份、年龄、体长、估计、SE、区间及 numerical_ok 的长表。
value.en: A long table containing quantity, report name, time, age, length, estimate, SE, interval and numerical_ok.

details.zh:
估计来自 report，SE 只按完整、精确同名的 est_std 行提取。未报告 SE 时保留 NA，不造出区间。F 保留原分组和每模型步单位，不自动求平均或年化。FA 使用存活区间的起始年龄和时期；正态区间不截零。

`conf_level` 指构造近似区间所用的名义置信水平。经验覆盖率是有效模拟区间包含对应真值的比例，由 summarize_simulations() 另行汇总。
details.en:
Estimates use report and complete exact-name SE rows from est_std. Missing uncertainty remains NA. F retains native groups and per-step units without averaging or annualization. FA uses source ages and periods. Normal intervals are not truncated at zero.

`conf_level` specifies the nominal confidence level used to construct the approximate intervals. Empirical coverage is the proportion of eligible simulation intervals containing their corresponding true values and is reported separately by summarize_simulations().

description.zh: 提取参数、尺度与固定状态
description.en: Extract parameters, scales and estimation status

value.zh: 参数表，包括估计、SE、区间、固定／估计／停用状态及数值检查标记。
value.en: A parameter table with estimates, SEs, intervals, fixed/estimated/inactive status and the numerical-screen flag.

details.zh:
有完整配方时包括固定参数；其 SE 和区间为 NA。旧对象仅能可靠列出自由固定效应。自然尺度 SE 用 delta method，区间转换内部尺度 Wald 端点；exp(mean_log_F) 和 exp(mean_log_R) 是过程基准水平，不是时间算术平均。检查 numerical_ok 后再解释不确定性。

`conf_level` 指构造近似区间所用的名义置信水平。经验覆盖率是有效模拟区间包含对应真值的比例，由 summarize_simulations() 另行汇总。
details.en:
With a recipe, fixed parameters are included with NA uncertainty. Legacy objects expose only free fixed effects. Natural-scale SEs use the delta method; intervals transform internal Wald endpoints. exp(mean_log_F) and exp(mean_log_R) is a process baseline, not a time average. Inspect numerical_ok before interpreting uncertainty.

`conf_level` specifies the nominal confidence level used to construct the approximate intervals. Empirical coverage is the proportion of eligible simulation intervals containing their corresponding true values and is reported separately by summarize_simulations().

description.en: Fit named sensitivity scenarios on common observations with serial or socket execution.
description.zh: 在同一观测数据上串行或 socket 并行拟合具名敏感性情景。

value.en: A list with named fits/error records, resolved settings, status, elapsed, estimates, model, F_summary and workers.
value.zh: 返回具名拟合/错误记录、完整设置、状态、耗时、估计长表、模型、F 汇总方式和工作进程数。

details.en: Warnings and failed numerical screens remain visible, with no automatic ranking. Each scenario uses the nstarts of the bundle or of the call; otherwise one start, the rule of hindcast_model() and retro_model(). Fits omit session-specific obj pointers; refit_model() can rebuild a live objective. This interface does not implement checkpoint/resume.
details.zh: 保留警告和未通过数值筛查的结果，不自动排名。每个情景使用 x 或调用中的 nstarts，未设置时为 1 个初值，与 hindcast_model()、retro_model() 相同。结果移除会话专用 obj 指针，需要可执行目标函数时使用 refit_model()；本接口不实现断点续跑。

figure.code: fit_scenarios(x, list(reference = list(), low_M = list(M = 0.15), high_M = list(M = 0.25)), model = "acl")

description.en: Inspect effective parameter starts, bounds and free/fixed/tied restrictions.
description.zh: 查看实际初值、上下界，以及自由、固定或共享的参数状态。

value.en: A data frame with parameter, kind, start, natural_start, lower, upper, transform, status, map_source, size, dimensions, n_free, n_fixed and n_tied.
value.zh: 包含 parameter、kind、start、natural_start、lower、upper、transform、status、map_source、size、dimensions、n_free、n_fixed、n_tied 的数据框。

details.en: Uses actual data-derived starts, clamped free starts, recruitment-age bounds, default maps and shared-F restrictions. kind=fixed_effect means an outer-model parameter, not necessarily a parameter fixed by map. Status can be free, fixed, tied, mixed or inactive. map_source distinguishes default, explicit, unmapped and F_structure. Random blocks start at zero; n_free counts independent mapped values and n_tied counts additional entries sharing them. exp(mean_log_R) and exp(mean_log_F) are baseline process levels on the natural scale, not arithmetic means; random natural_start is a multiplier. No compilation is performed.
details.zh: 使用真实的数据初值、按上下界截断的自由初值、补充年龄约束、默认 map 和共享 F 约束。kind=fixed_effect 指外层模型参数，并不表示该参数被 map 固定。status 可为 free、fixed、tied、mixed 或 inactive；map_source 区分 default、explicit、unmapped 和 F_structure。随机效应块初值为零，n_free 为独立映射值数量，n_tied 为共享这些值的额外元素数量。exp(mean_log_R) 和 exp(mean_log_F) 是自然尺度上的过程基准水平，不是算术平均值；随机效应的 natural_start 是乘数。全程无需编译。

description.en: Prepare a reusable input bundle from tables, three CSV files or an Excel workbook.
description.zh: 把三张数据表、三个 CSV 文件或 Excel 工作簿整理为可直接拟合的输入列表。

value.en: A structured list containing data.CatL, data.wgt, data.mat, fit_args and optional fit_config.
value.zh: 包含 data.CatL、data.wgt、data.mat、fit_args 以及可选 fit_config 的结构化列表。

details.en: This constructor converts numeric text safely and checks table values and alignment. It never fills or reorders missing periods and does not infer biology. Supply rec.age, nage, M, sel_L50 and sel_L95 in fit_args, then run check_alscl_data(x, model). Settings follow shared fit_args, selected fit_config, then explicit run arguments; list-valued settings replace the entire corresponding list. Named NULL map releases remain intact. Zeros remain zeros until the fitting zero_action excludes or rejects them.
details.zh: 安全转换数字文本，并检查三表的数值和排列是否一致；不填补或重排缺失时段，也不推测生物学参数。在 fit_args 中提供 rec.age、nage、M、sel_L50、sel_L95，再运行 check_alscl_data(x, model)。优先级为共享 fit_args、选中的 fit_config、显式运行参数；列表参数整体替换，具名 NULL 的 map 释放规则保留。零值在导入后仍为零，由拟合的 zero_action 决定排除或拒绝。

description.en: Fix a free scalar at each grid value and reoptimize the remaining parameters and random effects.
description.zh: 逐网格固定一个自由标量参数，重新优化其余参数及随机效应。

value.en: A list containing grid diagnostics, objectives and delta_nll, portable fits, resolved settings, reference objective and timing.
value.zh: 返回网格诊断、目标函数及 delta_nll、可移植拟合、完整设置、参照目标值和耗时。

details.en: Other free scalar starts come from the fitted optimum; fixed values and named NULL releases are preserved. At least one other free scalar must remain. delta_nll is relative to the original fit and can be negative, prompting rechecking of that optimum. Failed points remain visible. No automatic confidence intervals or chi-square cutoffs are provided. External assumptions use fit_scenarios().
details.zh: 其余自由标量初值取自拟合最优点，保留固定值和具名 NULL 释放。必须至少保留一个其他自由标量。delta_nll 相对于原拟合，可为负值并提示重查最优点。保留失败点，不自动生成置信区间或卡方阈值；外部假设使用 fit_scenarios()。

description.en: Project explicit deterministic population scenarios from the terminal fitted ACL or ALSCL state.
description.zh: 从 ACL 或 ALSCL 拟合末期状态开始，按明确给定的假设推演确定性种群情景。

value.en: summary contains year, N, B, SSB, Rec, CN, CB, F_mean and F_apical. trajectories and fishing_mortality are long tables. states contains NA, NL and ALSCL NLA; catch contains CNA and CNL. Supplied biology, F, time grid and assumptions are retained. CN is numbers; CB uses the supplied individual-weight units.
value.zh: summary 包含时间、总数量 N、生物量 B、SSB、补充量 Rec、捕捞数量 CN、捕捞生物量 CB、F_mean 和 F_apical；trajectories 和 fishing_mortality 为长表。states 保存 NA、NL 及 ALSCL 的 NLA；catch 保存 CNA 和 CNL。结果同时保留未来生物资料、F、时间轴及假设。CN 为数量，CB 的单位由个体体重单位决定。

details.en: Population states, B and SSB are at the start of each future period. The first future state survives the terminal fitted population through terminal fitted F and original M, then receives the first future recruitment. Future F[t]/M[t] determine catch[t] and survival into t+1, so a one-period F change affects catch but not start-of-period SSB. ACL advances ages and the plus group through its fitted age-length key; ALSCL applies length-specific survival before its fitted growth matrix. ACL catch biomass is derived by mapping catch-at-age through the fitted key. F_mean is an unweighted group mean and F_apical a group maximum; neither annualizes quarterly rates. These are deterministic conditional scenarios with fixed growth, explicit recruitment and future biology, no uncertainty intervals, no estimated stock-recruitment relationship and no automatic MSY/TAC calculation. Fits explicitly failing the numerical screen are rejected by default. allow_failed_fit = TRUE permits exploratory projection with a warning. Missing legacy diagnostics are recorded as unknown, not passed; assumptions retain the status and override.
details.zh: 种群状态、B 和 SSB 对应每个未来时段开始时。第一期未来状态先让拟合末期种群经历末期拟合 F 和原始 M 的死亡，再加入第一期未来补充量。未来 F[t]/M[t] 决定该期捕捞以及进入 t+1 的存活，因此仅改变一期 F 会改变当期捕捞，而不会改变期初 SSB。ACL 推进年龄组和末龄加组，并使用拟合的年龄–体长键；ALSCL 先按体长存活，再通过拟合的生长矩阵。ACL 的捕捞生物量由年龄捕捞量经该键转换得到。F_mean 是组间未加权平均值，F_apical 是组间最大值，均不把季度死亡率换算成年率。这是固定生长、明确补充量与未来生物资料的确定性条件情景，没有不确定性区间、没有估计的亲体量–补充量关系，也不自动计算 MSY/TAC。 明确未通过数值检查的拟合默认拒绝投影。allow_failed_fit = TRUE 可在警告后进行探索性投影；旧结果缺少诊断时记为 unknown，不视为通过。assumptions 保存状态及是否覆盖。

figure.code: project_model(a, F = F_future, recruitment = R_future, weight = w, maturity = m)

description.zh: 读取可移植评估存档
description.en: Read a portable assessment archive

value.zh: 带完整配方和估计结果的 alscl_fit 对象；没有活跃 obj。
value.en: An alscl_fit with its complete recipe and estimates, without a live obj.

details.zh: 校验存档格式和 schema。读取后可使用 summary、提取函数和基于报告的绘图；需要活跃模型时重新拟合。
details.en: Validates the archive format and schema. Summaries, extractors and report-based plots work after reading; refit to obtain a live model.

description.en: Read aligned survey, weight and maturity tables from three CSV files.
description.zh: 从三个 CSV 文件读取对齐的调查、体重和成熟比例数据表。

value.en: A named list containing the three numeric data tables, ready for prepare_alscl_data().
value.zh: 包含三张数值数据表的具名列表，可交给 prepare_alscl_data()。

details.en: The first column contains length-bin labels and subsequent headers contain numeric time labels. Blank cells and NA represent missing values. Numeric text is converted without using factor level codes. Rows and columns retain their original order. Weight and maturity tables must be complete; survey zeros and missing values remain explicit. Biological inputs are not inferred.
details.zh: 第一列为体长组标签，后续表头为数值时间标签。空白单元格和 NA 表示缺失；数字文本按显示值转换，不使用因子内部编码。保留原始行列顺序。体重和成熟比例必须完整，调查数据的零值和缺失值保留，不推测生物学输入。

description.en: Read survey, weight and maturity sheets from an Excel workbook.
description.zh: 读取 Excel 工作簿中的调查、体重和成熟比例工作表。

value.en: A named list containing the three numeric data tables.
value.zh: 包含三张数值数据表的具名列表。

details.en: Requires the optional readxl package. Sheet names must match exactly. The first column is the length-bin label; remaining headers are numeric time labels. The reader applies the same value and alignment checks as read_survey_csv(), preserves zero and missing survey cells, and does not infer biology or fill missing periods.
details.zh: 需要可选的 readxl 包。工作表名称必须完全一致。第一列为体长组标签，后续表头为数值时间标签。使用与 read_survey_csv() 相同的数值和对齐检查；保留调查零值和缺失值，不推测生物学输入或填补时段。

description.zh: 按保存配方重新拟合
description.en: Refit a stored assessment recipe

value.zh: 新的拟合结果、更新后的配方和当前会话活跃 TMB 对象。
value.en: A fresh fit with an updated recipe and live TMB object.

details.zh: 默认复用原始初值、完整输入与记录的 AD／标准误设置；完成后恢复调用者速度选项。除非显式 output=TRUE，否则不写绘图文件。更换软件版本不保证逐位一致。 recipe$implementation 记录可取得的源码提交、核心模板及头文件摘要、R 源文件摘要和运行环境。无法恢复的来源保持未知。重新拟合会提示已知实现或依赖变化；元数据相同不保证跨平台数值一致。
details.en: Reuses original starts, complete inputs and recorded AD/SE settings, restoring caller options afterward. File output is disabled unless output=TRUE is explicit. Bitwise identity across software versions is not guaranteed. recipe$implementation records available source revision, core-template/header hashes, source R hashes and runtime metadata. Unavailable provenance remains unknown. Refitting warns about known implementation/dependency changes; matching metadata does not guarantee cross-platform equality.

description.zh: 保存完整可移植评估
description.en: Save a portable assessment

value.zh: 不可见地返回文件路径；不修改原拟合。
value.en: Invisibly returns the file path without changing the original fit.

details.zh: 存档剔除会话专属 obj 指针，保存配方、输入、map、边界、设置、版本和报告。失败时保留原存档。配方不等于可跨会话执行的 TMB 指针；重建需要 refit_model()。 recipe$implementation 记录可取得的源码提交、核心模板及头文件摘要、R 源文件摘要和运行环境。无法恢复的来源保持未知。重新拟合会提示已知实现或依赖变化；元数据相同不保证跨平台数值一致。
details.en: The archive omits the session-specific obj pointer and retains inputs, maps, bounds, settings, versions and reports. Failed replacement preserves the old archive. Use refit_model() to rebuild a live TMB model. recipe$implementation records available source revision, core-template/header hashes, source R hashes and runtime metadata. Unavailable provenance remains unknown. Refitting warns about known implementation/dependency changes; matching metadata does not guarantee cross-platform equality.

description.en: Convenience interface for simulation batches fitted with ALSCL.
description.zh: 使用 ALSCL 拟合模拟批次的便捷入口。

value.en: A named list of replicate fits or error records, including iter and elapsed. Every result also replaces its `result_rep_<id>` file.
value.zh: 返回包含 iter 和 elapsed 的具名拟合或错误记录列表；每个结果同时替换对应 `result_rep_<id>` 文件。

details.en:
Recorded time and length coordinates are retained. Each replicate uses one inner fitting worker and sequential standard errors. Failed reruns replace old success files. M and F are per model step. This fits operating-model simulations; it does not automatically create a fitted parametric bootstrap. nstarts sets independent starts per replicate; these run sequentially inside each outer worker. train_times sets optimization passes per start. start_diagnostics records each attempt.

Replicate IDs must be distinct nonnegative integers, including 0, in `sim_data()`, `sim_model()`, `sim_acl()` and `sim_alscl()`. Simulation uses each ID as its seed and fitting reads the matching `sim_rep<id>` file.
details.zh:
保留模拟文件中的时间和体长坐标。每次拟合内部使用一个进程及顺序标准误。失败重跑会替换旧成功文件。M、F 均为每模型时间步单位。这是操作模型模拟数据拟合，不自动构成拟合模型参数自助法。 nstarts 设置每个重复的独立初值数，在外层工作进程内依次运行；train_times 是每个初值的优化轮数。start_diagnostics 保留每次尝试。

`sim_data()`、`sim_model()`、`sim_acl()` 和 `sim_alscl()` 的重复编号须为互不重复的非负整数，可以包含 0。模拟以编号作为随机种子，拟合读取对应的 `sim_rep<id>` 文件。

description.en: Fit ACL or ALSCL to saved simulation replicates using the same batch pipeline.
description.zh: 使用统一批次流程，把 ACL 或 ALSCL 拟合到已保存的模拟重复数据。

value.en: A named list of replicate fits or error records, including iter and elapsed. Every result also replaces its `result_rep_<id>` file.
value.zh: 返回包含 iter 和 elapsed 的具名拟合或错误记录列表；每个结果同时替换对应 `result_rep_<id>` 文件。

details.en:
Recorded time and length coordinates are retained. Each replicate uses one inner fitting worker and sequential standard errors. Failed reruns replace old success files. M and F are per model step. This fits operating-model simulations; it does not automatically create a fitted parametric bootstrap. nstarts sets independent starts per replicate; these run sequentially inside each outer worker. train_times sets optimization passes per start. start_diagnostics records each attempt.

Replicate IDs must be distinct nonnegative integers, including 0, in `sim_data()`, `sim_model()`, `sim_acl()` and `sim_alscl()`. Simulation uses each ID as its seed and fitting reads the matching `sim_rep<id>` file.

Before fitting, the saved q_surv vector is checked against its logistic catchability metadata. If metadata are absent, the curve is recovered from interior probabilities and checked against the full vector. Inconsistent files produce an error record; regenerate the simulation from matching parameters and biology rather than fitting mislabeled observations.
details.zh:
保留模拟文件中的时间和体长坐标。每次拟合内部使用一个进程及顺序标准误。失败重跑会替换旧成功文件。M、F 均为每模型时间步单位。这是操作模型模拟数据拟合，不自动构成拟合模型参数自助法。 nstarts 设置每个重复的独立初值数，在外层工作进程内依次运行；train_times 是每个初值的优化轮数。start_diagnostics 保留每次尝试。

`sim_data()`、`sim_model()`、`sim_acl()` 和 `sim_alscl()` 的重复编号须为互不重复的非负整数，可以包含 0。模拟以编号作为随机种子，拟合读取对应的 `sim_rep<id>` 文件。

拟合前核对已保存的 q_surv 向量与 logistic 可捕性元数据。缺少元数据时，从非边界概率恢复曲线并核对完整向量。不一致的文件产生错误记录；应使用匹配的参数与生物学数组重新生成模拟，避免拟合标注错误的观测。

description.en: Summarize simulation bias, RMSE, interval coverage, fitting failures and timing with explicit denominators.
description.zh: 使用明确分母汇总模拟偏差、RMSE、区间覆盖率、拟合失败与耗时。

value.en: A list with summary pooled over replicates/time by quantity, per-replicate status/timing and all pointwise estimates/truth, including failures.
value.zh: 返回按量跨重复/时间合并的 summary、逐重复状态/耗时，以及保留失败点的逐点估计和真值。

details.en:
Bias/RMSE use numerically valid estimate pairs; coverage additionally requires finite reported SEs. Attempted/valid replicate, point and interval counts and failure_rate are reported. Missing SEs are not counted as failed coverage. Relative bias excludes zero truth. F is excluded because its aggregation and uncertainty must be explicitly defined. These conditional performance summaries are not proof of general model superiority.

`conf_level` specifies the nominal confidence level used to construct the approximate intervals. Empirical coverage is the proportion of eligible simulation intervals containing their corresponding true values and is reported separately by summarize_simulations().

Both the time coordinates and each quantity must be one-dimensional real numeric vectors. Matrices and arrays are rejected even when their total length matches the number of periods. Aggregate age- or length-specific quantities to the intended time series before calling; do not flatten grouped values into time.
details.zh:
偏差和 RMSE 使用数值有效估计对，覆盖率额外要求有限的报告标准误。报告尝试/有效重复、点及区间数和 failure_rate。缺失标准误不算覆盖失败。相对偏差排除真值为零的点。F 因需要明确定义聚合和不确定性而排除。这些条件性能统计不证明模型普遍更优。

`conf_level` 指构造近似区间所用的名义置信水平。经验覆盖率是有效模拟区间包含对应真值的比例，由 summarize_simulations() 另行汇总。

时间坐标和每个量必须是一维实数数值向量。矩阵和数组即使总长度与时间步数相同也会被拒绝。先将年龄别或体长别数量按所需定义汇总为时间序列，不要把分组数据直接展平当作时间。

description.en: Simulate survey observations conditionally on a fitted population or after resampling its process deviations.
description.zh: 给定拟合种群状态，或重新抽取其过程偏差后，模拟调查观测。

value.en: simulations contains named replicates with x, observations and truth; metadata records the process, seed/RNG, coordinates, original observation mask, source numerical status and parameter_uncertainty = none. Truth includes year, population quantities, native group-specific F, scalar parameters, random effects and expected indices.
value.zh: simulations 为具名重复，每项含可直接拟合的 x、observations 及 truth；metadata 记录过程模式、种子／随机数生成器、坐标、原观测掩码、源数值状态和 parameter_uncertainty = none。真值包括时间、种群量、原生组别 F、标量参数、随机效应及期望指数。

details.en:
Conditional simulation holds fitted states fixed and varies lognormal observation errors. Resampling draws stationary AR(1) recruitment, separable group/time AR(1) F (or shared time-only F) and independent initial-age deviations, then evaluates the existing C++ population equations without optimization. Scales are marginal SDs. Scalar parameters, biology and catchability remain fixed. Fixed/tied random-effect maps are rejected for resampling; no parameter uncertainty or bootstrap intervals are added. Explicit seeds restore caller RNG state; original NA/zero cells are preserved by default. Known failed fits require an explicit warned override. Portable saved fits are supported.

Each returned input bundle retains the source fit’s effective fixed scalar values, including a fixed mean_log_R originally derived from data. Free parameters retain their original starting-value strategy. New ALSCL reports include dev_log_N0 in conditional truth after saving and reading; older reports without it return NULL.
details.zh:
条件模式固定拟合状态，只改变对数正态观测误差。过程重抽样使用平稳 AR(1) 补充、可分离组别／时间 AR(1) F（或仅时间共用 F）及独立初始年龄偏差，再调用现有 C++ 种群方程，无须优化。过程尺度为边际标准差。标量参数、生物学和可捕性保持固定；重抽样拒绝固定／绑定随机效应的 map，不加入参数不确定性或自助法区间。显式种子会恢复调用者随机数状态；默认保留原 NA／零位置。已知失败拟合须显式覆盖并警告。支持读取后的可移植拟合。

每个返回的输入列表保留源拟合的实际固定标量值，包括原先由数据计算后固定的 mean_log_R。自由参数保持原初值策略。新 ALSCL 报告在保存和读取后，条件真值仍包含 dev_log_N0；缺少该字段的旧报告返回 NULL。

description.en: Fit expanding training windows and score survey-index point predictions against genuinely withheld periods.
description.zh: 逐步扩展训练窗口，对真正留出的调查指数进行点预测并评分。

value.en: predictions is a length/time/fold table with observed, model and persistence predictions on the log scale, errors, scaling denominators and inclusion status. scores reports paired log RMSE/MAE, log MASE and counts by horizon. diagnostics, recipes, settings, start_diagnostics and process_paths retain fit status, failures, warnings and reproduction details; fits are optional.
value.zh: predictions 按体长／时间／折列出观测、模型和持平基准的对数预测、误差、尺度分母及纳入状态。scores 按期距报告配对对数 RMSE／MAE、对数 MASE 与计数。diagnostics、recipes、settings、start_diagnostics、process_paths 保留状态、失败、警告和复现细节；可选保存 fits。

details.en: Uses the last eligible origins with at least min_train periods and the complete horizon. Each fold fits truncated inputs; no full-series fit supplies starts. Future log recruitment/F deviations follow AR(1) conditional-mean paths, then population transitions give plug-in survey predictions, not marginal predictive means or predictive intervals. Biology is carried forward from the training endpoint. Fixed/tied time-varying random-effect maps are rejected. Failed/unverified fits remain visible but unscored. Scores use paired positive observations with an available persistence forecast; log MASE scales by consecutive training log changes within each length. Zero/undefined scales remain missing. ncores parallelizes folds; starts and SEs are sequential inside each fold. User-supplied assumptions must be chosen without tuning to held-out data.
details.zh: 使用至少 min_train 个训练期且能留出完整 horizon 的最后若干起点。每折只拟合截短输入，不使用完整序列拟合估计作为初值。未来对数补充／F 偏差沿 AR(1) 条件均值路径延伸，经种群转移得到代入式调查预测，不是边际预测均值或预测区间。未来生物学沿用训练末期。拒绝固定／绑定随时间变化随机效应的 map。失败／未确认数值状态的拟合保留但不评分。评分使用具备持平预测的配对正观测；对数 MASE 按同体长组连续训练对数差缩放，零／未知分母保持缺失。ncores 并行折，每折内初值和标准误顺序运行。手动假设应在不参考留出数据调参的前提下确定。
